title: Supervisor De Experiência Do Cliente (Zendesk) em campina grande (PB)
description:
Supervisor (a) de Experiência do Cliente (Zendesk)

No Quindim, a gente não acredita em "atendimento ao cliente". A gente acredita em nutrir relações. Buscamos uma liderança que saiba unir o toque humano da nossa curadoria com a precisão que a tecnologia oferece. Alguém que enxergue o Zendesk não apenas como uma ferramenta de tickets, mas como o canal que garante que a jornada da Família Quindim seja tão fluida e encantadora quanto a leitura de um bom livro.

Sua missão será orquestrar o equilíbrio entre Pessoas, Processos e Ferramentas, garantindo que nosso time tenha as melhores condições para acolher cada família com agilidade e afeto.

Responsabilidades

1. Cuidar da nossa engrenagem técnica (Zendesk Admin)

Olhar Estratégico: Configurar gatilhos, automações e macros que facilitem a vida do time e tragam respostas rápidas para as famílias.

Inteligência de Dados: Estruturar campos e formulários para que os dados do Zendesk Explore nos ajudem a entender de verdade as necessidades de quem está com a gente.

Central de Ajuda: Manter nossa FAQ sempre atualizada e acolhedora, incentivando a autonomia das famílias.

2. Cultivar Talentos e Relações

Presença e Escuta: Conduzir rituais (Dailies, 1:1s) mantendo o time engajado e conectado ao nosso propósito.

Qualidade com Afeto: Realizar monitorias constantes, transformando cada interação em uma oportunidade de aprendizado e refinamento do nosso tom de voz.

Planejamento: Dimensionar o time conforme o Quindim cresce, garantindo que o cuidado não se perca na escala.

3. Voz da Família e Melhoria Contínua

Gestão por Indicadores: Monitorar KPIs (NPS, CSAT, tempos de resposta) sempre com o foco na satisfação real de quem assina.

Ponte Interna: Traduzir os feedbacks das famílias em sugestões práticas para os times de Produto, Logística e Marketing.

Qualificações

O que buscamos em você:

Experiência em Liderança: Vivência em gestão de equipes de Customer Experience, preferencialmente em ambientes dinâmicos.

Domínio do Zendesk: Experiência prática na configuração da ferramenta (nível administrador).

Perfil Analítico e Humano: Capacidade de ler números sem esquecer que eles representam pessoas.

Comunicação Impecável: Alinhada com os valores de empatia e clareza do Quindim.

Diferenciais que nos encantam:

Passagem por modelos de assinatura ou e-commerce.

Vivência com integração de APIs ou outras ferramentas de CX.

Benefícios

Remuneração competitiva, em modalidade PJ.

Bonificação por desempenho.

Plano de Saúde (após 3 meses de prestação de serviço).

Plano Odontológico (após 3 meses de prestação de serviço).

Modelo de trabalho presencial em fase de imersão, com plano de transição para modelo híbrido, conforme metas de estabilização da operação.

Day off no aniversário.

Acesso ilimitado a livros infantis incríveis!

Diversidade e Inclusão

No Clube Quindim, acreditamos que a pluralidade é nossa força. Valorizamos e incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas negras, indígenas, LGBTQIA+, mulheres e mães.

Aprovar termos de referência técnicos para contratação de serviços e empreiteiras, garantindo a clareza dos requisitos e a aderência às normas técnicas e legais;
Coordenar atividades de fiscalização e perícia técnica nas obras, assegurando o cumprimento das normas regulatórias e a integridade das estruturas e instalações;
Monitorar indicadores de desempenho da execução das obras, analisar desvios e propor ações corretivas para garantir a entrega dos resultados esperados;
Controlar o orçamento das obras sob sua responsabilidade, acompanhar despesas, prevenir desvios e promover o uso eficiente dos recursos financeiros;
Dar suporte técnico às áreas correlatas e clientes internos, esclarecer dúvidas, propor soluções e contribuir para a resolução de problemas operacionais;
Supervisionar oregistro e a atualização de informações sobre manutenção e melhorias dos projetos, assegurando a rastreabilidade e a gestão do conhecimento técnico;
Garantir o cumprimento das normas de segurança, meio ambiente e saúde no trabalho, promovendo a cultura de prevenção e mitigação de riscos nas frentes de obra. O que oferecemos:
Vale Transporte;

Licença maternidade 6 meses e paternidade 20 dias

Seguro de Vida;
PLR;
Wellhub;
Programa Fale Comigo (assessoria gratuita e sigilosa via telefone para auxílio psicológico, jurídico, financeiro, social). Conheça um pouco sobre nós:
Nós atuamos no segmento de energia elétrica do Brasil e temos uma história sólida, desde 1912, de contribuição para o desenvolvimento das cidades e estados que atendemos por meio de soluções em geração, transmissão, distribuição, comercialização de energia e prestação de serviços.
Desde 2017, o Grupo faz parte da State Grid, maior empresa de energia elétrica do mundo, fortalecendo a nossa estratégia de crescimento e o protagonismo no setor elétrico brasileiro.
Através das nossas distribuidoras levamos energia para mais de 10 milhões de endereços, o que corresponde a mais de 22 milhões de pessoas atendidas com a eficiência da nossa rede de atendimento.
Acreditamos que equipes plurais e um ambiente inclusivo para todas as pessoas são fundamentais para a sustentabilidade de organizações inovadoras e com foco em clientes, por isso, valorizamos a pluralidade e orientamos nossas ações para garantir uma cultura inclusiva e oportunidades a todas as pessoas.

title: Professor de espanhol em recife (PE)
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!AIdioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.
Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online:você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.
Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco.
Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*O que oferecemos?Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo auma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeosde treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis,com vídeos totalmente atualizados.
Mentorias semanaiscom especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
Plataformaexclusivapara acompanhamento das aulas.
Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.
Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.
Necessário: Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanaispara treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.
O diferencial?Aqui você é mais que um professor.
Você será parte deuma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.
Estanão é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.
Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.
Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, aiicom certeza é o seu lugar.
Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas.
Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!O que eu faço?Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.
QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.
Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.
Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Data operations analyst em recife (PE)
description:
About Us: Yipit Data is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475 M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1 B.
Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.
Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world's top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions.
From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.
We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India.
Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc.as a Best Workplacefor three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.
What It's Like to Work at Yipit Data: Yipit Data isn't a place for coasting—it's a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals.
From day one, you'll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.
Why Top Talent Chooses Yipit Data: Ownership That Matters : You'll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you're hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—Yipit Data might be the opportunity you've been waiting for.
About The Role: The Data Operations Analyst plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our retail and brand customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions.
The core of this role isapplying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs.
Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success.
The Data Operations Analyst works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations.
This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale.
As Our Data Operations Analyst, You Will: Transform raw, messy product and transaction data into structured, customer-ready metrics.
Apply judgment to resolve ambiguity in data, including handling incomplete, incorrect, or inconsistent inputs.
Define and implement rules and logic that make data analytically meaningful and comparable over time.
Build and maintain mappings, benchmarks, and normalization approaches that allow customer data to be analyzed at scale.
Execute product categorization and attribution when needed as part of broader metric-building workflows.
Identify data quality issues and determine appropriate tradeoffs when perfect data is not available.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan and deliver data projects on time and with high accuracy.
Ensure consistency and reliability of outputs across customers while accounting for customer-specific nuances.
Continuously improve processes and workflows to increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.
Take ownership of deliverables and be accountable for the quality and usability of the final data.
You Are Likely To Succeed If You Have...
1–3 years of experience working in a data-focused role such as data operations, analytics, research, or data quality.
Strong analytical judgmentand comfort making decisions in ambiguous or imperfect data environments.
Experience turning raw data into structured outputs, metrics, or analyses that others rely on.
The ability to reason through edge cases, inconsistencies, and tradeoffs in real-world data.
High attention to detail paired with an understanding of how data decisions impact downstream analysis.
Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining accuracy and accountability.
Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain data assumptions and decisions to internal stakeholders.
Experience using SQL, Python, or similar tools for data exploration, validation, or automation.
Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).
Technical Skills (Helpful but Not Required): Comfort working with large datasets using spreadsheets, internal tools, or data platforms.
Familiarity with data transformation, data quality checks, or analytics workflows.
Exposure to product, retail, or consumer data is a plus.
What We Offer: Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact.
You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals.
We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities We care about your personal life, and we mean it.
We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more! Your growth at Yipit Data is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics.
Everyone at Yipit Data is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
Personal laptop Health and wellness package Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position.
If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.
We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status.
We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.
Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Engenheiro de dados - júnior em fortaleza (CE)
description:
Engenheiro de Dados - Júnior A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.
Sobre a Rethink Somos uma consultoria que unetecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitaispara solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras.
Agora comoparte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.
Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas.
Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.
Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgásconfiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.
Diversidade e Inclusão Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantirambientes mais diversos e inclusivos.
Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura demulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência.
Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?Qual será o seu papel? Como Engenheiro de Dados Júnior, seu papel será crucial no apoio à construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados robustos e eficientes, principalmente no ambiente Databricks.
Você será responsável por garantir a entrega contínua de dados transformados e governados, desde a ingestão até a disponibilização para consumo analítico.
Sua atuação contribuirá diretamente para a qualidade, confiabilidade e acessibilidade dos dados, sendo um membro fundamental na equipe de engenharia de dados.
Como será seu dia a dia? Apoiar a construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados no Databricks, utilizando notebooks, jobs e pipelines; Garantir a entrega contínua das camadas Bronze, Silver e Gold dentro da arquitetura de dados; Ingerir, transformar e disponibilizar dados para consumo analítico; Criar e manter tabelas Delta e views para suporte a dashboards e análises; Atuar com compartilhamento e consumo de dados via Delta Sharing; Apoiar a governança de dados utilizando Unity Catalog, gerenciando catálogos, schemas e permissões; Monitorar execuções de pipelines, identificar falhas e realizar troubleshooting; Corrigir causas-raiz e propor melhorias de confiabilidade e performance; Implementar e/ou apoiar validações de qualidade de dados; Documentar pipelines, regras de negócio e a linhagem básica dos dados; Colaborar com analistas, times de BI e áreas de negócio para entendimento de requisitos e evolução das entregas.
Para esta vaga, é essencial: Conhecimento sólido de SQL (joins, agregações, CTEs, window functions e modelagem básica para analytics); Conhecimento prático de Python para dados (manipulação, leitura/escrita e organização de código em notebooks); Noções de Apache Spark/Databricks (Data Frames, particionamento, leitura/escrita em Delta e execução distribuída em alto nível); Experiência inicial com Databricks (uso de notebooks, jobs, clusters e boas práticas básicas); Familiaridade com pipelines de dados e arquitetura Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold), mesmo em contexto acadêmico ou projetos; Conhecimento em Git e controle de versão (branch, PR e resolução simples de conflitos); Capacidade de investigar problemas (logs, métricas simples, reprocessamentos) e comunicar status com clareza; Disponibilidade para atuar com sustentação de rotinas, acompanhando falhas e correções dentro do horário acordado.
Você pode se destacar se: Tiver experiência com Azure Data Factory (pipelines, triggers, integrações, parâmetros, monitoramento).
Possuir conhecimento prático de Unity Catalog (permissões, data access, boas práticas de governança).
Tiver vivência com Delta Sharing (publicação/consumo e cuidados com segurança e contratos de dados).
Possuir experiência com orquestração e automação (Databricks Workflows, CI/CD, Databricks Repos, Azure Dev Ops/Git Hub Actions).
Tiver conhecimento em Data Quality e Observabilidade (ex.: Great Expectations/Deequ, métricas, SLIs/SLOs, alertas).

title: Professor de inglês em recife (PE)
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!AIdioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.
Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online:você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.
Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco.
Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*O que oferecemos?Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo auma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeosde treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis,com vídeos totalmente atualizados.
Mentorias semanaiscom especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
Plataformaexclusivapara acompanhamento das aulas.
Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.
Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.
Necessário: Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanaispara treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.
O diferencial?Aqui você é mais que um professor.
Você será parte deuma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.
Estanão é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.
Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.
Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, aiicom certeza é o seu lugar.
Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas.
Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!O que eu faço?Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.
QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.
Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.
Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Senior data engineer em brasília (RN)
description:
Data Engineer Brazil Data Analyst II Important Information Location: Brazil Job Mode: Full-time Work Mode: Work from home Job Summary As a SQL & Snowflake Engineer, you will play a key role in the full development lifecycle, translating complex data structures into actionable technical insights with a specific focus on Snowflake and SQL queries.
You will be responsible for both querying and analyzing large datasets within the Data Lake to support feature development, ensuring seamless data availability from ingestion through to reporting within an Agile framework.
Beyond technical execution, you will act as a key contributor in data modeling, actively participating in technical discussions to help the engineering team understand underlying data patterns and quality issues.

Essential Skills Solid Experience with Snowflake (architecture, warehousing, and data sharing); Strong proficiency in Advanced SQL (CTEs, Window Functions, Stored Procedures); Familiarity with ETL/ELT processes and data ingestion tools; Solid experience with version control for database scripts (Git, Liquibase, or dbt).
Highly Desirable Skills Cloud knowledge (AWS/Azure/GCP) regarding data storage (S3/Blob); Experience with Python or scripting for data manipulation; Familiarity with semi-structured data (JSON, Parquet) with Snowflake.

description:

We combine deep market insight with an agile, thesis-driven approach to back transformative technologies shaping the future of finance and the internet.

Analyze market trends, narratives, and macro developments across crypto and AI ecosystems.
Evaluate investment opportunities, including token projects, early-stage startups, and infrastructure plays.
Build investment theses and present insights to internal stakeholders.
Monitor portfolio performance and track key metrics across projects.
Collaborate with internal teams on strategy, deal flow, and market positioning.
Stay ahead of industry developments, identifying early signals and high-potential opportunities.

Strong understanding of blockchain, De Fi, tokenomics, and Web3 ecosystems.
Solid knowledge or strong interest in artificial intelligence and its investment landscape.
Exceptional analytical and research skills with the ability to synthesize complex information.
Experience evaluating startups, token models, or market opportunities.
Ability to think independently and form high-conviction investment views.
Fluent English with strong written communication skills.
High level of curiosity, ownership, and performance orientation.

Remote-first: Fully remote (Poland-based) with flexible working hours.
Direct investment exposure: Work on real deals and high-impact decisions.

If you're passionate about Web3, AI, and investing , and want to operate where innovation meets capital, we'd love to connect.

You be your own boss and set your own schedule Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).

Descrição O Engenheiro de Soluções deve apoiar o crescimento de vendas da Good We desenvolvendo fortes relacionamentos com os stakeholders técnicos da rede de distribuidores, instaladores e EPCs da Good We no Brasil, garantindo a confiança deles nas soluções e produtos da Good We.
Conduzir treinamentos presenciais e online para os clientes, criar e gerenciar documentação técnica local, estabelecer uma base de conhecimento e representar a Good We em exposições.
Fornecer informações ou feedbacks em tempo hábil para propostas de clientes, fornecendo os detalhes técnicos das soluções propostas.
Responsabilidades Realizar workshops e treinamentos presenciais para parceiros e clientes; Realizar webinars e treinamentos online para parceiros e clientes; Apoiar as equipes de vendas na especificação de projetos; Apoiar as equipes de vendas em visitas a clientes em negociações estratégicas; Realizar simulações de projetos e design para clientes; Realizar tradução de documentos técnicos (fichas técnicas, manuais de usuário, brochuras, apresentações de revistas, etc.); Criar e desenvolver apresentações de portfólio; Criar e desenvolver apresentações de produtos e funcionalidades; Criar documentos de SOP sobre produtos e funcionalidades; Criar vídeos de SOP sobre produtos e funcionalidades; Gerenciar e participar de exposições e feiras de energia solar (FV); Realizar palestras e apresentações presenciais em fóruns e eventos de energia solar (FV); Fornecer treinamento para a equipe interna brasileira (engenheiros de pós-vendas, equipes de marketing, equipes de vendas, etc.); Configurar e gerenciar a comunidade online da Good We Solar Academy no Brasil; Configurar e gerenciar as redes sociais da Good We Solar Academy no Brasil; Prestar suporte ao cliente em questões de Pré-Vendas; Treinar e certificar a equipe técnica dos parceiros de acordo com a política de canais; Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as equipes da matriz para entender e transmitir as especificações corretas do nosso portfólio para a equipe local, parceiros e clientes; Trabalhar ativamente com a equipe de marketing para estabelecer uma rede de promoção com parceiros de terceiros (empresas de treinamento, influenciadores digitais e distribuidores); Apoiar a equipe de marketing na criação de conteúdo e promoções; Configurar e estabelecer um centro de treinamento no Brasil; Apoiar os gerentes de Produtos e Pré-Vendas na definição do portfólio local; Coletar demandas de produtos do mercado brasileiro; Analisar as demandas de mercado e propor novos produtos e funcionalidades; Coletar e organizar informações sobre produtos, soluções e principais informações de clientes concorrentes; Analisar e fornecer feedback sobre requisitos de normas regulatórias locais.
Habilidades Requeridas Proficiência em mandarim Graduação em Engenharia Elétrica, Fotovoltaica, Energias Renováveis ou formação similar; Conhecimento avançado de inversores fotovoltaicos; Pelo menos 2 anos de experiência com inversores fotovoltaicos; Pelo menos 3 anos de experiência no mercado fotovoltaico brasileiro; Experiência com GD, experiência com projetos de GC é um diferencial; Experiência com inversores de armazenamento de energia fotovoltaica; Experiência com baterias de chumbo-ácido e lítio para sistemas de armazenamento fotovoltaico; Conhecimento geral de eletricidade, produtos, soluções de produtos e processos; Excelentes conhecimentos em Auto CAD e PVSyst; Fortes habilidades analíticas, atenção aos detalhes e habilidades de comunicação; Domínio do MS Office e outros softwares de energia solar (PV); Conhecimento avançado em MS Power Point; Ampla rede de contatos no setor de energia renovável, principalmente na indústria solar fotovoltaica; Fortes habilidades de ensino e comunicação.
Atributos Proatividade; Excelentes habilidades organizacionais com capacidade de rapidamente avaliar prioridades; Mentalidade internacional para um ambiente multicultural; Fortes relações no mercado fotovoltaico brasileiro; Trabalho em equipe; Independência (trabalhar sem supervisão direta); Senso de urgência; Multitarefa; Disponibilidade para viagens de negócios; Disponibilidade para se mudar de cidade.

title: Electrical engineering pod lead - 72132 em recife (PE)
description:
About Turing: Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world's leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems.
Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P& LJob Overview: An Electrical Engineering Pod Leadresponsible for managing a small team creatingsimulation-based design problemsused to train and evaluate advanced AI models.
The role ownsproblem quality, reproducible environments, and coordination with AI researchers , and requires strong EE domain depth plushands-on Python, Docker, and basic cloudskills to review and support the pod end-to-end.
Key Responsibilities: Team Leadership Lead and manage a pod of 4–8 Engineering Design Specialists by assigning tasks, reviewing deliverables, removing blockers, and mentoring on problem design, simulation rigor, and documentation.
Act as the main point of contact with AI research teams to translate model feedback into refinements, while running regular syncs, tracking progress, and reporting updates and risks to program leads.
Technical Oversight Oversee and approve pod outputs, maintain reproducible Docker-based simulation environments, support cloud infrastructure for simulation/grading, Develop and review Python automation/validation, and proactively resolve dependency, versioning, and reproducibility issues.
Problem Design (Individual Contribution) Personally design a portfolio of high-difficulty electrical engineering problems in your chosen subdomain.
Set the quality bar and design philosophy for the pod through your own example submissions.
Electrical Engineering Subdomains: You must have deep expertise in at least one of the following, with working familiarity across others being a strong plus: Analog / Mixed-Signal IC Design — op-amp topologies, ADC/DAC design, noise analysis, layout-aware design, SPICE-level simulation.
Power Electronics — DC-DC converters, inverter design, magnetics sizing, thermal management, efficiency optimization.
RF / Microwave Engineering — filter design, impedance matching, S-parameter analysis, transmission line and antenna design.
Digital Systems / FPGA / ASIC — RTL design, timing closure, synthesis-aware design, hardware-software co-design.
Embedded Systems — microcontroller/DSP-based design, real-time constraints, peripheral interfacing, power budgeting.
Required Qualifications: Master's degree or Ph D in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline.
At least 5 years of hands-on electrical engineering design experience, with a track record of owning designs from specification through validated implementation.
At least 1–2 years of experience in a technical lead, senior engineer, or team coordination role.
Proficiency with Python for scripting, automation, and simulation workflows.
Hands-on experience with Docker: building images, writing Dockerfiles, managing containerized environments.
Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — comfortable running workloads, managing storage, and monitoring jobs.
Proficiency with at least one open-source EE simulation tool (e.g., ngspice, Py Spice, Qucs, Open EMS, scikit-rf, or similar).
Nice-to-Have: Experience designing engineering coursework, exam problems, or design challenges at graduate level.
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or automated testing frameworks.
Exposure to LLM evaluation, AI benchmarking, or training data curation.
Cross-domain familiarity with Control Systems, Embedded/Robotics, or Power Systems.
Evaluation Process: Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form.
Shortlisted candidates will receive a Job Interest Form.
After the initial profile review, we will share anassessment , which must be completed within24 hours.
Based on the assessment submission and your responses, we may schedule aninterview round.
Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss thepre‐onboarding requirements.
After applying, you will receive an email with a login link.
Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.
Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Strategic partnership & alliance em recife (PE)
description:
About Rate Gain Rate Gain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered Saa S solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion.
Rate Gain today is one of the world's largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.
Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today Rate Gain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.
Exploring the role Rate Gain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world's largest chains.
Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions.
As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, Rate Gain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.
The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives.
The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.
This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind.
This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.
How your day will look like/Job responsibility Build and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.g.
RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs) Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with Rate Gain's GTM strategy in LATAM Identify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystem Collaborate with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal) to structure and execute partnership agreements Represent Rate Gain in industry events and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutions Monitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenue Provide regular reporting and insights on partnership outcomes and market trends Education & Work Experience Bachelor's degree in business, Marketing, or a related field 5+ years of experience in business development or strategic partnerships Knowledge: In-depth understanding of the LATAM hospitality and travel technology ecosystem Knowledge of Saa S business models and partnership structures Awareness of regional trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscape in the travel and hospitality sectors Skills: Strong negotiation and deal-closing capabilities Excellent relationship management skills with ability to engage partners at all levels Advanced verbal and written communication skills in Spanish, Portuguese, and English Ability to identify, pitch, and convert strategic partnership opportunities Proficiency in using CRM and sales enablement tools Skilled in cross-functional collaboration with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Product, etc.)Attitude: Proactive and results-oriented, with a strong drive to exceed targets Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for growth and innovation Culturally sensitive and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively in a global, remote team High level of to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace.

title: Senior ruby on rails engineer em fortaleza (CE)
description:
About Stay Fi Stay Fi combines Io T and marketing technology for the vacation rental industry (think Airbnb hosts).
With our product, vacation rental managers can create a meshable Wi Fi guest network with a custom-branded Wi Fi login page that collects guest information.
Our software lets them monitor their network remotely and integrates with their marketing tools to help them build relationships with their guests and grow their business.
Over the past 8 years, we've built our business from the ground up without the help of large investors.
This means we're growing a sustainable business and we run it independently.
We're a small team so each team member has a big impact on our product and business.
And we're creating tools that our customers truly love.
About You You're a senior full stack Ruby on Rails developer with 7+ years of professional experience building and shipping production applications.
You're a product-minded engineer who takes ownership.
You think beyond each task / ticket and consider the broader impact of your technical decisions on the business.
You write expressive, readable, and maintainable code and hold yourself and others to a high standard through thoughtful code reviews.
You have a strong command of Rails conventions but know when and how to diverge from them pragmatically.
You're comfortable navigating and improving legacy codebases, not just greenfield projects.
You're curious about Io T, Wi Fi, and building sophisticated 3rd party API integrations.
You're energized by working on a small team where your decisions carry real weight.
About the Role Write full stack code using Ruby on Rails, Postgre SQL, Tailwind CSS, React and Java Script, and deploy it via Heroku, Azure and AWS.
Take ownership of large, complex projects: from scoping and architecture through to delivery in close collaboration with the CTO.
Identify and address performance bottlenecks, technical debt, and architectural weaknesses proactively.
Build and maintain robust API integrations with 3rd party software providers.
Lead by example in pull request culture; writing clear descriptions, giving constructive feedback, and raising the bar for the whole team.
Contribute to engineering standards, tooling decisions, and best practices as a senior voice on the team.
Why Work at Stay Fi?You'll work directly with the CTO and CEO on mission-critical projects with real ownership and autonomy.
Your experience and judgment will directly shape the technical direction of the product.
You'll have an outsized impact both within our company and across the vacation rental industryin a way that's rarely possible at larger organizations.
As you continue to help our business grow, you can expect increases in your salary or hourly rate.

description:

This role sits at the intersection of Developer Experience, Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, and Applied AI , focused on integrating AI-assisted tooling, LLM workflows, and automation into the software development lifecycle.
The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience with LLM APIs, AI developer tooling, Python automation, cloud infrastructure, and developer productivity metrics , while helping shape internal AI governance, adoption frameworks, and scalable engineering "golden paths."Key Responsibilities Champion an AI-first engineering culturethrough reusable playbooks, golden-path templates, and best practices that improve developer productivity.
Define and measure impact using DORA and SPACE metrics , driving improvements across engineering workflows.
Build reusable patterns for: AI-assisted code generation Pull request automation Test generation Debugging workflows Developer self-service enablement Evaluate, prototype, and lead POCs for AI tools , providing recommendations based on ROI, usability, technical merit, and stakeholder feedback.
Manage AI usage governance, including: Token budgeting and cost controls Usage monitoring and reporting PII redaction guardrails Audit logging and responsible AI practices Develop lightweight AWS-based infrastructure supporting LLM pipelines , APIs, and AI integrations.
Integrate AI tooling into Git Lab CI/CD, Git Ops workflows, and developer platforms.
Instrument AI workflows with observability metrics and usage signals to support adoption and optimization.
Partner with engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to drive AI enablement initiatives.
Required Qualifications 8+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, Developer Experience , or related engineering roles.
Strong hands-on experience with LLM APIs and AI-assisted developer toolingin production or enterprise settings.
Strong Python development skills for automation and AI workflow integrations.
Experience evaluating, procuring, or governing AI/Saa S tools , including vendor assessments, licensing, and cost management.
Practical daily usage of tools such as Git Hub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Chat GPT , or similar.
Experience designing scalable developer workflows, internal platforms, or self-service engineering capabilities.
Strong AWS experience, ideally including: Bedrock API Gateway Managed AI/Cloud Services Experience with Terraform, Helm, Git Ops, and CI/CD pipelines(Git Lab preferred).
Strong observability mindset with experience defining meaningful metrics and instrumentation.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Preferred / Nice to Have Experience contributing to an AI Enablement function, Developer Experience program, or Center of Excellence.
Hands-on experience with: LLM Agents RAG pipelines Vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector, Open Search, etc.) Lang Chain / Llama Index Exposure to AI Fin Ops , usage reporting, and cost attribution models.
Knowledge of AI governance and security , including: OWASP Top 10 for LLMs Prompt injection risks Model supply chain security Responsible AI controls Financial services or insurance domain experience is a plus.

title: Emerging market trader em brasília (RN)
description:
Role Overview We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team.
The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows.
This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.
Key Responsibilities FX Trading & Liquidity Management Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies , with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS)or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS)markets.
Source and maintaindeep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desksacross relevant regions.
Executespot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC tradesto optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
Monitormarket developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamicsacross EM FX markets.
Hedging Strategy & Risk Management Design and implement FX hedging strategiesto manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
Optimize hedging efficiency acrossmultiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity poolswhere relevant.
Develop models fordynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization.
Monitor risk limits, Pn L, and exposure across currency books.
Trading Infrastructure & Systems Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure , including: Automatedhedging engines Liquidity aggregation systems Smart order routing Pricing and risk management tools Integrate connectivity withbanks, ECNs, and liquidity providersvia APIs or FIX protocols.
Improveexecution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring.
Market Development Identify and onboardnew liquidity providers and OTC trading partnersacross emerging markets.
Build pricing frameworks forilliquid currency pairsand support new corridor launches.
Contribute to the development ofscalable FX infrastructuresupporting global payments and settlement flows.
Requirements Experience 5–10+ years of FX trading experiencein Emerging Markets.
Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies , such as: Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS Experience working at: Global banks EM FX trading firms Payment / fintech companies Crypto exchanges or market makers Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades.
Technical Expertise Deep understanding of: FX market microstructure in illiquid markets NDF markets and offshore hedging Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks Hands-on experience building or optimizing: FX trading systems Hedging engines Liquidity aggregation platforms Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution.
Skills Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
Ability to operate inhigh-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments.
Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks.
Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Preferred Qualifications Experience supportinghigh-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations.
Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources.
Familiarity withstablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies.
Background inbuilding or scaling FX market-making operations.
Strong analytical and problem solving skills Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments Vision & Mission OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a Pay Fi innovator.
Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network.
Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption.
The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2 B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float.
Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications.
With OSL Pay and Stable X, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion.
As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives.
We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Emerging market trader em recife (PE)
description:
Role Overview We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team.
The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows.
This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.
Key Responsibilities FX Trading & Liquidity Management Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies , with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS)or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS)markets.
Source and maintaindeep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desksacross relevant regions.
Executespot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC tradesto optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
Monitormarket developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamicsacross EM FX markets.
Hedging Strategy & Risk Management Design and implement FX hedging strategiesto manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
Optimize hedging efficiency acrossmultiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity poolswhere relevant.
Develop models fordynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization.
Monitor risk limits, Pn L, and exposure across currency books.
Trading Infrastructure & Systems Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure , including: Automatedhedging engines Liquidity aggregation systems Smart order routing Pricing and risk management tools Integrate connectivity withbanks, ECNs, and liquidity providersvia APIs or FIX protocols.
Improveexecution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring.
Market Development Identify and onboardnew liquidity providers and OTC trading partnersacross emerging markets.
Build pricing frameworks forilliquid currency pairsand support new corridor launches.
Contribute to the development ofscalable FX infrastructuresupporting global payments and settlement flows.
Requirements Experience 5–10+ years of FX trading experiencein Emerging Markets.
Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies , such as: Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS Experience working at: Global banks EM FX trading firms Payment / fintech companies Crypto exchanges or market makers Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades.
Technical Expertise Deep understanding of: FX market microstructure in illiquid markets NDF markets and offshore hedging Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks Hands-on experience building or optimizing: FX trading systems Hedging engines Liquidity aggregation platforms Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution.
Skills Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
Ability to operate inhigh-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments.
Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks.
Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Preferred Qualifications Experience supportinghigh-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations.
Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources.
Familiarity withstablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies.
Background inbuilding or scaling FX market-making operations.
Strong analytical and problem solving skills Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments Vision & Mission OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a Pay Fi innovator.
Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network.
Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption.
The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2 B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float.
Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications.
With OSL Pay and Stable X, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion.
As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives.
We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

description:
This role is for the person who: Wants to help founders of e Commerce brands scale with confidence through clean, reliable financials.
Enjoys leading talented accountants and delivering clarity and insights founders can rely on.
Thrives in a tech-forward, growing environment where continuous improvement is encouraged.
The salary range for this role is CA$ $ 3000–6000 p/m, depending on location and experience.
To support our continued growth, this is an active position we're currently recruiting for.
About Up Counting We're afully remote, tech-poweredfirm helpinge Commerce and digital-first businesse s scale with confidence.
Our global team works asynchronously, giving everyone time for deep, meaningful focus.
We use smart systems and automation to deliver high-quality, efficient work across every department.
We prioritize a respectful, collaborative environment where people feel supported and have space for life outside of work.
We trust our team to lead with ownership and care — autonomy is part of our DNA.
What You'll Be Doing Team Leadership: Manage and mentor a team of Accountants to deliver accurate, timely, high-quality work.
Full-Cycle Accounting Oversight: Review reconciliations, financial reports, and month-end close deliverables across multiple client files.
Operational Excellence: Ensure Up Counting's accounting processes are followed consistently and improve them where needed.
Client Support & Communication: Help clients understand their numbers, communicate insights clearly, and ensure smooth financial operations.
System & Process Optimization: Identify automation opportunities and contribute to scalable, efficient workflows alongside Controllers and senior leadership.
What You Bring 5+ years of experience in accounting management, ideally within a firm or multi-client environment.
High proficiency in Quick Books Online and/or Xero (Net Suite is a bonus).
Excellent communication and leadership skills — you elevate the people around you.
Strong technical foundation across full-cycle accounting, reconciliations, and month-end processes.
Comfortable using automation tools and improving processes.
FP& A or financial modeling experience is an asset.
A calm, structured leadership style — you bring clarity without micromanagement.
Perks & Culture Because great work deserves a great place to do it.
Fully Remote + Async Work flexibly from anywhere.
During your first six months, you'll align closely with EST hours (9am–5pm) to onboard smoothly, then transition to 70% overlap.
Work from Anywhere We care about outcomes, not location.
Paid Time Off Enjoy paid time off, Me Days, Stat Holidays in your region, and our year-end company office closure.
Grow With Us We promote from within based on performance, leadership, reliability, and impact.
Continuous Learning We invest in your development through certifications, internal training, and ongoing learning.
Fair and Market-Aligned Compensation Competitive pay matched to your experience and local market.
Your Journey at Up Counting Your First Week Meet the People Team and Accounting leadership, onboard into our systems, connect with your direct reports, and understand our workflows across tools, teams, and time zones.
Month 1 You'll be managing client files, team rhythms, and weekly deliverables.
You'll be leading your team through core processes, learning the review system end-to-end, and begin shaping how we operate.
In 3 Months You'll fully own your portfolio of accountants and clients—setting priorities, supporting performance, ensuring high-quality delivery, and improving workflows.
You'll be a go-to leader with autonomy and clarity.
Curious About Our Values & Culture? They're built around excellence, autonomy, respect, and curiosity.
Learn more on our Careers Page.
How We Hire Our process is transparent, straightforward, and human: Apply via Typeform: Short questions + a brief video.
Introductory Call: A short conversation with our People Team to align expectations.
Scenario-Based Assessment + Technical Review: A strategic exercise reviewed by our senior finance team.
Final Interview: A culture and alignment conversation with leadership.
Offer: If it's a mutual fit, we move quickly — great partnerships shouldn't wait.
No cover letter needed, just tell us what drew you to Up Counting.
Every application is reviewed by our People team — we don't use AI to screen or assess candidates.
Thoughtful hiring matters to us.

description:
Role Overview We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team.
The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows.
This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.
Key Responsibilities FX Trading & Liquidity Management Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies , with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS)or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS)markets.
Source and maintaindeep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desksacross relevant regions.
Executespot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC tradesto optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
Monitormarket developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamicsacross EM FX markets.
Hedging Strategy & Risk Management Design and implement FX hedging strategiesto manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
Optimize hedging efficiency acrossmultiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity poolswhere relevant.
Develop models fordynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization.
Monitor risk limits, Pn L, and exposure across currency books.
Trading Infrastructure & Systems Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure , including: Automatedhedging engines Liquidity aggregation systems Smart order routing Pricing and risk management tools Integrate connectivity withbanks, ECNs, and liquidity providersvia APIs or FIX protocols.
Improveexecution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring.
Market Development Identify and onboardnew liquidity providers and OTC trading partnersacross emerging markets.
Build pricing frameworks forilliquid currency pairsand support new corridor launches.
Contribute to the development ofscalable FX infrastructuresupporting global payments and settlement flows.
Requirements Experience 5–10+ years of FX trading experiencein Emerging Markets.
Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies , such as: Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS Experience working at: Global banks EM FX trading firms Payment / fintech companies Crypto exchanges or market makers Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades.
Technical Expertise Deep understanding of: FX market microstructure in illiquid markets NDF markets and offshore hedging Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks Hands-on experience building or optimizing: FX trading systems Hedging engines Liquidity aggregation platforms Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution.
Skills Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
Ability to operate inhigh-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments.
Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks.
Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Preferred Qualifications Experience supportinghigh-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations.
Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources.
Familiarity withstablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies.
Background inbuilding or scaling FX market-making operations.
Strong analytical and problem solving skills Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments Vision & Mission OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a Pay Fi innovator.
Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network.
Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption.
The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2 B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float.
Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications.
With OSL Pay and Stable X, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion.
As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives.
We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Artificial intelligence engineer em juazeiro do norte (CE)
description:
Job Title: AI Engineer Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week) Contract Duration: Long Term Work Schedule:8 hours/day (Mon-Fri) Work Hours: PST Location:100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)Overview We are seeking an experienced AI Engineerto drive AI-first engineering practices and enable developer productivity at scale.
This role sits at the intersection of Developer Experience, Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, and Applied AI , focused on integrating AI-assisted tooling, LLM workflows, and automation into the software development lifecycle.
The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience with LLM APIs, AI developer tooling, Python automation, cloud infrastructure, and developer productivity metrics , while helping shape internal AI governance, adoption frameworks, and scalable engineering "golden paths."Key Responsibilities Champion an AI-first engineering culturethrough reusable playbooks, golden-path templates, and best practices that improve developer productivity.
Define and measure impact using DORA and SPACE metrics , driving improvements across engineering workflows.
Build reusable patterns for: AI-assisted code generation Pull request automation Test generation Debugging workflows Developer self-service enablement Evaluate, prototype, and lead POCs for AI tools , providing recommendations based on ROI, usability, technical merit, and stakeholder feedback.
Manage AI usage governance, including: Token budgeting and cost controls Usage monitoring and reporting PII redaction guardrails Audit logging and responsible AI practices Develop lightweight AWS-based infrastructure supporting LLM pipelines , APIs, and AI integrations.
Integrate AI tooling into Git Lab CI/CD, Git Ops workflows, and developer platforms.
Instrument AI workflows with observability metrics and usage signals to support adoption and optimization.
Partner with engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to drive AI enablement initiatives.
Required Qualifications 8+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, Developer Experience , or related engineering roles.
Strong hands-on experience with LLM APIs and AI-assisted developer toolingin production or enterprise settings.
Strong Python development skills for automation and AI workflow integrations.
Experience evaluating, procuring, or governing AI/Saa S tools , including vendor assessments, licensing, and cost management.
Practical daily usage of tools such as Git Hub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Chat GPT , or similar.
Experience designing scalable developer workflows, internal platforms, or self-service engineering capabilities.
Strong AWS experience, ideally including: Bedrock API Gateway Managed AI/Cloud Services Experience with Terraform, Helm, Git Ops, and CI/CD pipelines(Git Lab preferred).
Strong observability mindset with experience defining meaningful metrics and instrumentation.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Preferred / Nice to Have Experience contributing to an AI Enablement function, Developer Experience program, or Center of Excellence.
Hands-on experience with: LLM Agents RAG pipelines Vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector, Open Search, etc.) Lang Chain / Llama Index Exposure to AI Fin Ops , usage reporting, and cost attribution models.
Knowledge of AI governance and security , including: OWASP Top 10 for LLMs Prompt injection risks Model supply chain security Responsible AI controls Financial services or insurance domain experience is a plus.

title: Fx trader em brasília (RN)
description:
Role Overview We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team.
The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows.
This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.
Key Responsibilities FX Trading & Liquidity Management Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies , with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS)or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS)markets.
Source and maintaindeep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desksacross relevant regions.
Executespot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC tradesto optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
Monitormarket developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamicsacross EM FX markets.
Hedging Strategy & Risk Management Design and implement FX hedging strategiesto manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
Optimize hedging efficiency acrossmultiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity poolswhere relevant.
Develop models fordynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization.
Monitor risk limits, Pn L, and exposure across currency books.
Trading Infrastructure & Systems Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure , including: Automatedhedging engines Liquidity aggregation systems Smart order routing Pricing and risk management tools Integrate connectivity withbanks, ECNs, and liquidity providersvia APIs or FIX protocols.
Improveexecution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring.
Market Development Identify and onboardnew liquidity providers and OTC trading partnersacross emerging markets.
Build pricing frameworks forilliquid currency pairsand support new corridor launches.
Contribute to the development ofscalable FX infrastructuresupporting global payments and settlement flows.
Requirements Experience 5–10+ years of FX trading experiencein Emerging Markets.
Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies , such as: Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS Experience working at: Global banks EM FX trading firms Payment / fintech companies Crypto exchanges or market makers Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades.
Technical Expertise Deep understanding of: FX market microstructure in illiquid markets NDF markets and offshore hedging Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks Hands-on experience building or optimizing: FX trading systems Hedging engines Liquidity aggregation platforms Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution.
Skills Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
Ability to operate inhigh-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments.
Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks.
Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Preferred Qualifications Experience supportinghigh-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations.
Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources.
Familiarity withstablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies.
Background inbuilding or scaling FX market-making operations.
Strong analytical and problem solving skills Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments Vision & Mission OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a Pay Fi innovator.
Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network.
Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption.
The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2 B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float.
Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications.
With OSL Pay and Stable X, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion.
As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives.
We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.
