title: Lifecycle & retention strategist (klaviyo) em aracaju (SE)
description:
ABOUT ATTN AGENCY
ATTN Agency (pronounced Attention Agency) is a boutique, performance-driven digital marketing agency trusted by e-commerce and DTC brands looking to scale profitably. We specialize in full-funnel growth across Google, Meta, Tik Tok, Klaviyo, Postscript, and emerging platforms — with a laser focus on ROAS, new customer acquisition, and incremental revenue.
We don't just manage emails. We build scalable systems for sustainable growth and we're selective about who we work with and who we hire. If you're obsessed with performance, welcome home.
ABOUT THE ROLE
We are looking for a Senior Lifecycle and Retention Strategist to own and drive retention strategy across a portfolio of high-growth e Commerce and DTC brands. This is a senior, client-facing role that sits at the intersection of strategy, analytics, and execution oversight.
You will be responsible for building and managing full lifecycle programs spanning email, SMS, direct mail, and loyalty, while leading the strategic direction for each brand on your portfolio. You think in customer journeys, speak fluently in data, and know how to translate insights into programs that move revenue.
You will also play a key role in evaluating and recommending the right tech stack for each client, including loyalty platforms, subscription tools, review integrations, and emerging retention channels, ensuring every brand is set up with the right infrastructure to scale.
This is not a coordinator role. We need someone who has been here before, can lead without being managed, and is ready to take ownership of outcomes.
SCOPE OF WORK
Strategy and Campaign Planning
Own the lifecycle roadmap across email, SMS, direct mail, and loyalty for a portfolio of 5 to 7 high-growth e Commerce brands
Develop rolling 30-day campaign calendars aligned with product launches, promotions, and paid media activity
Write clear, detailed copy briefs and flow outlines tailored to each brand's voice, tone, and audience
Build segmentation frameworks and customer journey maps designed to maximize engagement and lifetime value
Leverage AI tools and advanced analytics to uncover opportunities and improve workflow efficiency
Delegate campaign and flow builds to Retention Coordinators, then review, QA, and deliver actionable feedback
Coordinate with design and copy teams to keep assets and Click Up timelines on track
Mentor junior team members and actively contribute to growing their strategic and technical capabilities Optimization and Performance
Analyze performance across deliverability, engagement, conversion rate, revenue per recipient, and cohort LTV
Design and execute A/B and multivariate tests across creative, cadence, offers, and segments and translate results into clear next steps
Refine benchmarks, identify trends, and get ahead of problems before they affect performance
Evaluate and pilot emerging retention channels including loyalty tiers, push notifications, and in-app messaging
Document learnings and contribute to internal best practice development and team training Tech Stack Management and Recommendations
Audit existing client tech stacks, identify gaps, and recommend the right tools for each brand's stage of growth
Advise on and help implement solutions across loyalty and rewards (Yotpo, Smile.io, Loyalty Lion), subscription management (Recharge, Skio, Stay), review and UGC platforms (Okendo, Stamped, Junip), SMS (Postscript, Attentive, Klaviyo SMS), post-purchase tools (Wonderment, Malomo, After Ship), push notifications, and direct mail (Post Pilot, Paper Run, etc.)
Stay current on the retention technology landscape and bring proactive recommendations to clients and the internal team Client Collaboration
Join monthly or bi-weekly client calls led by Account Managers to present strategy, performance insights, and testing roadmaps
Deliver concise, data-driven performance summaries that clearly communicate wins, gaps, and next steps
Partner with Account Managers to ensure retention strategy integrates seamlessly with each client's broader growth initiatives
REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE
4+ years of lifecycle and retention marketing experience, the majority within e Commerce or DTC
Proven track record managing email and SMS programs that have directly contributed to measurable revenue growth
Deep knowledge of Klaviyo including flows, segmentation, deliverability, and performance analysis
Experience managing multiple client accounts simultaneously, preferably in an agency environment
Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, spot trends, and build a clear strategic response
Solid understanding of the e Commerce retention tech ecosystem with the ability to make confident platform recommendations
Experience briefing and managing creative and copy teams
Excellent written and verbal communication skills including the ability to present strategy clearly to clients
Comfortable working autonomously in a fast-paced remote environment
Proficiency with Click Up (Or similar project management platform), Slack, and GSuite
NICE TO HAVE
Experience with SMS platforms such as Postscript or Attentive
Hands-on experience implementing or managing loyalty and subscription tools
Familiarity with direct mail as a retention channel
Experience mentoring or managing junior team members
Experience with other ESPs like Braze, Iterable, and Salesforce Marketing Cloud
HOW WE WORK
You will work directly with our Director of Lifecycle and Retention Marketing and collaborate closely with Account Managers, additional Retention Strategists, designers, and copywriters. We operate through Click Up for project management and Slack for day-to-day communication. Availability and responsiveness between 9am and 5pm US hours on business days is required.

title: Gerente de projeto de design em campo largo (PI)
description:
Sobre a vaga
A Bas-Alto é um estúdio de design full-service que opera sob o modelo de fractional design team: o fundador atua como design lead embedded em empresas parceiras, integrado aos times e às decisões de produto e de marca. A Bas-Alto é a estrutura que sustenta essa atuação: um time de designers entregando produto, web e visual design em paralelo, com o Gerente de Projetos/Design Ops garantindo que tudo opere com consistência enquanto o fundador está focado na frente estratégica. Site para referência:
Estamos contratando um(a) Gerente de Projetos de Design para trabalhar como \" braço direito operacional \" do fundador do estúdio na gestão de projetos de design. O papel central é garantir que o time de designers tenha sempre briefings claros, prioridades bem definidas e entregas organizadas, mantendo múltiplos projetos simultâneos rodando com qualidade e sem perder prazo.
Responsabilidades
Relacionamento com os clientes no dia a dia , respondendo a dúvidas, alinhando expectativas e garantindo que estejam sempre informados sobre o andamento dos projetos (por escrito, em inglês). Suporte direto ao design lead na condução dos projetos e organização de demandas Criação de briefings executáveis que traduzem as necessidades e objetivos em projetos para a equipe de design Gerenciar tarefas , entregas e prazos em plataformas como Click Up, Asana, Notion ou similares Acompanhar o andamento de entregas de design (produto, web e marketing), garantindo qualidade e consistência
Fazer o handoff das entregas finais para os clientes, garantindo clareza, organização e um padrão elevado de apresentação
Estruturar fluxos de trabalho, cronogramas e processos internos
Antecipar gargalos, resolver impedimentos e manter os projetos em movimento Diferencial: D ireção de design dos projetos (para candidatos com background sólido em design)
Necessário
Experiência sólida em gestão de projetos , de preferência em estúdios de design, agências ou startups Experiência sólida no setor de tecnologia e de gestão de produtos digitais Familiaridade com Figma e com o universo de design: entender o que são um wireframe, um design system, uma entrega de UI ou um fluxo de UX. Inglês fluente em escrita e leitura. Extrema organização e atenção a detalhe para manejar múltiplas frentes ao mesmo tempo Comunicação clara e objetiva, tanto com clientes quanto com a equipe
Domínio de ferramentas de gestão de projetos (Click Up, Asana, Notion, Jira ou similares)
Experiência com um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico/ágil de startups
Remuneração e modelo
Salário a partir de R$ 3.600+, podendo ser significativamente maior para candidatos com background sólido em design (que consigam atuar também na direção de design dos projetos).
Contratação: CLT ou PJ, a negociar
Formato de trabalho: 100% remoto
Horário flexível. Obs.: É necessária disponibilidade para atender demandas também no período noturno, devido ao fuso horário dos clientes da Califórnia (4h antes do horário do Brasil).

Experiência sólida em gestão de projetos , de preferência em estúdios de design, agências ou startups Experiência sólida no setor de tecnologia e de gestão de produtos digitais Familiaridade com Figma e com o universo de design: entender o que são um wireframe, um design system, uma entrega de UI ou um fluxo de UX. Experiência com um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico/ágil de startups

Salário a partir de R$ 3.600+, podendo ser significativamente maior para candidatos com background sólido em design (que consigam atuar também na direção de design dos projetos).

Tight, technical team where engineering quality is a first-class concern.

title: Lifecycle & retention strategist (klaviyo) em são paulo (RN)
description:
ABOUT ATTN AGENCY
ATTN Agency (pronounced Attention Agency) is a boutique, performance-driven digital marketing agency trusted by e-commerce and DTC brands looking to scale profitably. We specialize in full-funnel growth across Google, Meta, Tik Tok, Klaviyo, Postscript, and emerging platforms — with a laser focus on ROAS, new customer acquisition, and incremental revenue.
We don't just manage emails. We build scalable systems for sustainable growth and we're selective about who we work with and who we hire. If you're obsessed with performance, welcome home.
ABOUT THE ROLE
We are looking for a Senior Lifecycle and Retention Strategist to own and drive retention strategy across a portfolio of high-growth e Commerce and DTC brands. This is a senior, client-facing role that sits at the intersection of strategy, analytics, and execution oversight.
You will be responsible for building and managing full lifecycle programs spanning email, SMS, direct mail, and loyalty, while leading the strategic direction for each brand on your portfolio. You think in customer journeys, speak fluently in data, and know how to translate insights into programs that move revenue.
You will also play a key role in evaluating and recommending the right tech stack for each client, including loyalty platforms, subscription tools, review integrations, and emerging retention channels, ensuring every brand is set up with the right infrastructure to scale.
This is not a coordinator role. We need someone who has been here before, can lead without being managed, and is ready to take ownership of outcomes.
SCOPE OF WORK
Strategy and Campaign Planning
Own the lifecycle roadmap across email, SMS, direct mail, and loyalty for a portfolio of 5 to 7 high-growth e Commerce brands
Develop rolling 30-day campaign calendars aligned with product launches, promotions, and paid media activity
Write clear, detailed copy briefs and flow outlines tailored to each brand's voice, tone, and audience
Build segmentation frameworks and customer journey maps designed to maximize engagement and lifetime value
Leverage AI tools and advanced analytics to uncover opportunities and improve workflow efficiency
Delegate campaign and flow builds to Retention Coordinators, then review, QA, and deliver actionable feedback
Coordinate with design and copy teams to keep assets and Click Up timelines on track
Mentor junior team members and actively contribute to growing their strategic and technical capabilities Optimization and Performance
Analyze performance across deliverability, engagement, conversion rate, revenue per recipient, and cohort LTV
Design and execute A/B and multivariate tests across creative, cadence, offers, and segments and translate results into clear next steps
Refine benchmarks, identify trends, and get ahead of problems before they affect performance
Evaluate and pilot emerging retention channels including loyalty tiers, push notifications, and in-app messaging
Document learnings and contribute to internal best practice development and team training Tech Stack Management and Recommendations
Audit existing client tech stacks, identify gaps, and recommend the right tools for each brand's stage of growth
Advise on and help implement solutions across loyalty and rewards (Yotpo, Smile.io, Loyalty Lion), subscription management (Recharge, Skio, Stay), review and UGC platforms (Okendo, Stamped, Junip), SMS (Postscript, Attentive, Klaviyo SMS), post-purchase tools (Wonderment, Malomo, After Ship), push notifications, and direct mail (Post Pilot, Paper Run, etc.)
Stay current on the retention technology landscape and bring proactive recommendations to clients and the internal team Client Collaboration
Join monthly or bi-weekly client calls led by Account Managers to present strategy, performance insights, and testing roadmaps
Deliver concise, data-driven performance summaries that clearly communicate wins, gaps, and next steps
Partner with Account Managers to ensure retention strategy integrates seamlessly with each client's broader growth initiatives
REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE
4+ years of lifecycle and retention marketing experience, the majority within e Commerce or DTC
Proven track record managing email and SMS programs that have directly contributed to measurable revenue growth
Deep knowledge of Klaviyo including flows, segmentation, deliverability, and performance analysis
Experience managing multiple client accounts simultaneously, preferably in an agency environment
Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, spot trends, and build a clear strategic response
Solid understanding of the e Commerce retention tech ecosystem with the ability to make confident platform recommendations
Experience briefing and managing creative and copy teams
Excellent written and verbal communication skills including the ability to present strategy clearly to clients
Comfortable working autonomously in a fast-paced remote environment
Proficiency with Click Up (Or similar project management platform), Slack, and GSuite
NICE TO HAVE
Experience with SMS platforms such as Postscript or Attentive
Hands-on experience implementing or managing loyalty and subscription tools
Familiarity with direct mail as a retention channel
Experience mentoring or managing junior team members
Experience with other ESPs like Braze, Iterable, and Salesforce Marketing Cloud
HOW WE WORK
You will work directly with our Director of Lifecycle and Retention Marketing and collaborate closely with Account Managers, additional Retention Strategists, designers, and copywriters. We operate through Click Up for project management and Slack for day-to-day communication. Availability and responsiveness between 9am and 5pm US hours on business days is required.

title: Recuperador de vendas / closer comercial em espírito santo (RN)
description:
Vaga: Recuperador de Vendas / Closer Comercial — PJ Presencial Estamos contratando um Recuperador de Vendas experiente para atuar presencialmente na recuperação de oportunidades, reativação de leads e fechamento de vendas para uma solução de tecnologia: um chatbot para Whats App voltado para atendimento, automação, qualificação de leads e aumento de conversões.
Buscamos alguém com perfil comercial forte, experiência real em vendas, domínio de follow-up e capacidade de transformar leads parados, indecisos ou perdidos em clientes ativos. Local de trabalho
Presencial — Edifício Mubadalla Office Modelo de contratação
PJ Remuneração
Fixo de R$ 3.000,00 + comissionamento
Comissões iniciando em 4% e podendo chegar até 15% , conforme desempenho, metas e evolução comercial. Sobre o produto
Você irá atuar com a recuperação de vendas de uma plataforma de chatbot para Whats App que ajuda empresas a:
Automatizar atendimentos
Organizar conversas com clientes
Qualificar leads
Aumentar conversões
Melhorar a operação comercial
Reduzir perda de oportunidades no Whats App É um produto com alta demanda no mercado, especialmente para empresas que vendem pelo Whats App e precisam recuperar contatos, acelerar decisões e fechar oportunidades que ficaram pelo caminho. Responsabilidades
Recuperar leads que não fecharam na primeira abordagem
Reativar oportunidades paradas no funil comercial
Fazer follow-up estratégico com leads mornos e quentes
Identificar objeções e conduzir o lead até a decisão
Apresentar a solução de forma consultiva
Negociar condições e fechar contratos
Trabalhar com listas de leads antigos, leads perdidos e oportunidades em aberto
Manter rotina comercial organizada e disciplinada
Atualizar informações no CRM
Trabalhar com metas de recuperação, conversão e fechamento Requisitos
Experiência comprovada com vendas
Experiência com recuperação de vendas, reativação de leads, closer ou SDR será um diferencial forte
Boa comunicação verbal e escrita
Perfil persuasivo, consultivo e orientado a resultado
Capacidade de contornar objeções
Organização para lidar com alto volume de contatos
Disciplina para follow-up diário
Ambição para crescer junto com a empresa
Disponibilidade para trabalho presencial
Experiência com venda de tecnologia, Saa S, automação, marketing digital, infoprodutos ou serviços B2 B será um diferencial Perfil que buscamos Queremos alguém que saiba vender, insistir com inteligência e recuperar oportunidades sem parecer inconveniente.
Essa vaga é para uma pessoa comercial, resiliente, comunicativa e focada em resultado. Alguém que entenda que muitas vendas não são perdidas por falta de interesse, mas por falta de acompanhamento, timing e abordagem certa.
Buscamos uma pessoa com visão de crescimento, energia para construir junto e capacidade de assumir posições maiores conforme a empresa escala. Oportunidades de crescimento
A empresa está em fase de expansão, e a pessoa contratada poderá crescer para cargos como:
Gestor Comercial Head de Operações Liderança de equipe comercial
Estruturação de processos de recuperação de vendas
Participação estratégica no crescimento da operação Diferenciais
Produto com grande potencial de mercado
Comissão progressiva e agressiva
Carteira de oportunidades para recuperação
Ambiente de crescimento
Possibilidade real de assumir posição de liderança
Atuação direta com tecnologia, automação e vendas B2 B Como se candidatar Envie seu currículo e uma breve apresentação contando sua experiência com vendas, recuperação de leads ou fechamento comercial, e por que acredita que pode performar nessa vaga.

title: Gerente de projeto de design em são paulo (RN)
description:
Sobre a vaga
A Bas-Alto é um estúdio de design full-service que opera sob o modelo de fractional design team: o fundador atua como design lead embedded em empresas parceiras, integrado aos times e às decisões de produto e de marca. A Bas-Alto é a estrutura que sustenta essa atuação: um time de designers entregando produto, web e visual design em paralelo, com o Gerente de Projetos/Design Ops garantindo que tudo opere com consistência enquanto o fundador está focado na frente estratégica. Site para referência:
Estamos contratando um(a) Gerente de Projetos de Design para trabalhar como \" braço direito operacional \" do fundador do estúdio na gestão de projetos de design. O papel central é garantir que o time de designers tenha sempre briefings claros, prioridades bem definidas e entregas organizadas, mantendo múltiplos projetos simultâneos rodando com qualidade e sem perder prazo.
Responsabilidades
Relacionamento com os clientes no dia a dia , respondendo a dúvidas, alinhando expectativas e garantindo que estejam sempre informados sobre o andamento dos projetos (por escrito, em inglês). Suporte direto ao design lead na condução dos projetos e organização de demandas Criação de briefings executáveis que traduzem as necessidades e objetivos em projetos para a equipe de design Gerenciar tarefas , entregas e prazos em plataformas como Click Up, Asana, Notion ou similares Acompanhar o andamento de entregas de design (produto, web e marketing), garantindo qualidade e consistência
Fazer o handoff das entregas finais para os clientes, garantindo clareza, organização e um padrão elevado de apresentação
Estruturar fluxos de trabalho, cronogramas e processos internos
Antecipar gargalos, resolver impedimentos e manter os projetos em movimento Diferencial: D ireção de design dos projetos (para candidatos com background sólido em design)
Necessário
Experiência sólida em gestão de projetos , de preferência em estúdios de design, agências ou startups Experiência sólida no setor de tecnologia e de gestão de produtos digitais Familiaridade com Figma e com o universo de design: entender o que são um wireframe, um design system, uma entrega de UI ou um fluxo de UX. Inglês fluente em escrita e leitura. Extrema organização e atenção a detalhe para manejar múltiplas frentes ao mesmo tempo Comunicação clara e objetiva, tanto com clientes quanto com a equipe
Domínio de ferramentas de gestão de projetos (Click Up, Asana, Notion, Jira ou similares)
Experiência com um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico/ágil de startups
Remuneração e modelo
Salário a partir de R$ 3.600+, podendo ser significativamente maior para candidatos com background sólido em design (que consigam atuar também na direção de design dos projetos).
Contratação: CLT ou PJ, a negociar
Formato de trabalho: 100% remoto
Horário flexível. Obs.: É necessária disponibilidade para atender demandas também no período noturno, devido ao fuso horário dos clientes da Califórnia (4h antes do horário do Brasil).

title: Senior voip engineer em varginha (RN)
description:
About the role
We are hiring a Senior Vo IP Engineer to help shape and evolve a large-scale real-time communications platform, including the migration from legacy infrastructure to a modern architecture.
This role sits at the intersection of telecom, networking, and software engineering , and requires practical, production-grade experience across all three. You will contribute directly to architectural decisions, build new services, and improve voice systems that customers rely on every day.
This is a developer role — not an integrator or operator position. We are looking for someone who has written code that routes, manipulates, and reasons about SIP traffic at scale.
What you'll do
Design and develop services for a production-grade real-time communications platform.
Build and maintain telephony applications using open-source and commercial platforms.
Contribute to and help lead the migration from legacy infrastructure to a modern architecture.
Design and implement call routing logic, SIP signaling flows, and media handling.
Troubleshoot complex issues in live voice environments — signaling, media, performance, and reliability.
Partner closely with operations and cross-functional engineering teams to ensure service stability and scalability. What we're looking for:
Required 5+ years as a developer building Vo IP / SIP systems — not solely operating or integrating commercial platforms.
Hands-on production experience with both layers of an open-source SIP stack: A B2 BUA / media server: Asterisk or Free SWITCH
A SIP proxy / routing layer: Kamailio or Open SIPS
Proven track record building and operating voice platforms in production.
Solid understanding of SIP signaling, dialog state, NAT traversal, and real-time media behavior.
Comfort reading and writing code, not only configuration.
Advanced English proficiency (written and spoken). Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Strong plus Python for automation, tooling, or service development. SQL and cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
Containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
Event-driven architectures and messaging systems (Kafka, Rabbit MQ, NATS).
Dev Ops and automation tooling (Terraform, Ansible, CI/CD pipelines).
Exposure to RTPengine, Homer SIP capture, Web RTC gateways, or SBCs.
Experience contributing to or maintaining infrastructure-as-code.
Why this role
Fully remote with a flexible working model.
Direct ownership of architectural decisions on a platform handling real production traffic.
High-impact migration project — your work shapes the next generation of the platform.
Tight, technical team where engineering quality is a first-class concern.
Continuous learning culture with support for training and development.

title: Marketing ai agent builder em são luís (RN)
description:
Role Overview:
As our Marketing AI Agent Builder, you will be the lead architect for our \"agentic\" marketing stack. Your goal is to move beyond simple automation (if-this-then-that) toward autonomous systems that reason through marketing data, execute multi-channel campaigns, and self-correct based on performance. This is a \"Builder\" role—part Engineer, part Strategist, part Data Scientist. This is a remote role with the option to work anywhere in NA.
Core Responsibilities:
• Intelligent Research & Segmentation: Deploy agents to crawl the web for intent signals (hiring changes, funding, news) to dynamically update ICP segments and enrich CRM records in real-time.
• Autonomous Campaign Management: Build agents that independently monitor live campaigns (Search, Social, Email) and autonomously reallocate budgets or pause underperforming creatives based on real-time ROI.
• Dynamic Lead Nurturing: Design agents that use Natural Language Processing (NLP) to \"read\" prospect behavior and trigger personalized, multi-step nurture sequences without manual intervention.
• Performance & Guardrails: Establish \"human-in-the-loop\" protocols and evaluation frameworks to ensure agent outputs align with brand voice and security standards.
• System Orchestration: Connect AI agents to our core stack—including Hub Spot/Salesforce, 6sense, and Google Analytics—ensuring seamless data flow and automated write-backs to the CRM.
Qualifications & Skills:
• Experience: 2–4 years in Growth Engineering, ideally with experience scaling a mid-market Saa S revenue engine.
• AI Tooling: Proficiency with agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., Lang Graph, Crew AI) or low-code builder platforms (e.g., Claude Co Work, Code X)
• Agent Orchestration: Experience with low-code/no-code platforms (e.g., Clay, Zapier Central, Make.com) or code-based frameworks (e.g., Lang Graph, Crew AI).
• Prompt Engineering: Ability to design complex \"reasoning loops\" that prevent hallucinations and ensure professional, brand-aligned output.
• Data Savvy: Comfortable working with JSON, APIs, and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) to feed agents the right context from your company’s internal knowledge base.
• Marketing Expertise: Knowledge of B2 B buyer journeys, attribution models, and demand generation tactics.

description:
Kenvue is currently recruiting for a: Analista Sênior de Mídia e Influenciadores
What we do
At  Kenvue , we realize the extraordinary power of everyday care. Built on over a century of heritage and rooted in science, we’re the house of iconic brands - including NEUTROGENA®, AVEENO®, TYLENOL®, LISTERINE®, JOHNSON’S® and BAND-AID® that you already know and love. Science is our passion; care is our talent.
Who We Are
Our global team is ~ 22,000 brilliant people with a workplace culture where every voice matters, and every contribution is appreciated. We are passionate about insights, innovation and committed to delivering the best products to our customers. With expertise and empathy, being a Kenvuer means having the power to impact millions of people every day. We put people first, care fiercely, earn trust with science and solve with courage – and have brilliant opportunities waiting for you! Join us in shaping our future–and yours. For more information , click here .
Role reports to: GER MKT SR
Location: Latin America, Brazil, Sao Paulo, Sao Paulo
Work Location: Hybrid
What you will do
Buscamos um(a) Analista Sênior de Mídia e Influenciadores para atuar no planejamento, gestão e otimização de estratégias integradas de mídia paga e marketing de influência para grandes marcas.
Este(a) profissional terá papel estratégico na condução das campanhas, garantindo eficiência dos investimentos, relevância cultural e impacto direto nos resultados do negócio.
Procuramos alguém dinâmico(a), curioso(a) e altamente antenado(a) às tendências de social media, formatos, creators e movimentos digitais, com olhar crítico, propositivo e orientado à inovação.
Principais responsabilidades
Desenvolver e liderar o planejamento estratégico integrado de mídia paga e marketing de influência, alinhado aos objetivos de marca e negócio.
Atuar de forma estratégica na potencialização dos resultados de business por meio de mídia e creators, garantindo coerência com posicionamento, funil de comunicação e calendário de marca.
Gerenciar o plano de mídia junto às agências parceiras, acompanhando execução, otimizações, investimentos, pacing e eficiência de budget.
Planejar, selecionar e gerir estratégias com influenciadores e creators, assegurando relevância cultural, qualidade dos conteúdos, conformidade com guidelines de marca e boas práticas de publicidade.
Monitorar tendências de social media, formatos, plataformas e comportamento de audiência, incorporando inovação às estratégias.
Definir e acompanhar KPIs, métricas de sucesso e benchmarks, analisando performance e propondo ajustes táticos e estratégicos.
Consolidar dados de mídia e influenciadores, transformando resultados em insights acionáveis, relatórios executivos e recomendações para stakeholders internos.
Atuar como ponto de conexão entre times internos e parceiros externos (agências, creators e plataformas), contribuindo de forma colaborativa para a evolução da área.
Requisitos Mandatórios
Experiência sólida em planejamento e gestão de mídia (on e off) e marketing de influência.
Vivência com gestão de agências e análise de performance de campanhas.
Conhecimento aprofundado de métricas de mídia digital e influenciadores, conectadas a indicadores de branding e performance.
Perfil dinâmico, curioso, analítico e proativo, com forte interesse por social media e inovação.
Excelente organização e capacidade de gerenciar múltiplos projetos simultaneamente.
Diferenciais
Conhecimento de plataformas de influenciadores, social listening e ferramentas de análise.
Atuação em ambientes de alta complexidade e grande volume de investimento.
Interesse contínuo por tendências culturais, creators, memes e movimentos digitais.

The Sr. Business Analyst is responsible for managing financial and operational aspects of assigned clients and their products. This role requires a high level of understanding of the assigned clients and products, various speaker bureau project types, and the ability to work independently.
The Sr. Business Analyst works closely with the Director and financial analysts to ensure accurate internal and external financial reporting, develop budget proposals and provide financial related support in client meetings.
Financial
● Oversee day-to-day financial operations for speaker bureau, including budget tracking, internal revenue accruals, forecasting and variance analysis.
● Develops Statement of Work (SOW), ensuring final sign-off by Director as required.
● Create and manage budgets and proposals, providing oversight for complex SOWs. Prepare speaker bureau specific budgets, accrual reports and monthly financial management updates
● Work closely with program directors on monthly accrual reports, reviewing and discussing as needed.
● Ensure accuracy in financial reconciliation data before releasing reports to clients
● Generate and distribute monthly accruals and budget reports for clients
● Provide invoicing amounts to Accounts Receivable to facilitate timely invoice submissions
Operational
● Ensures compliance with internal Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and client specific SOPs.
● Provides budget related support in client meetings as needed.
● Participates in accrual meetings with clients based on their SOPs.
● Contributes to process improvement initiatives to enhance financial operations.
Experience and Skills
● 2+ Years experience in budgeting · Proficiency in Excel functions for financial modeling and analysis.
● Strong financial analysis skills, including budget tracking, forecasting and variance analysis · Excellent understanding of internal SOPs and ability to ensure compliance
● Familiar with all internal and external SOPs.
● Strives to find process efficiencies by thinking outside the box and making recommendations for change.
● Knowledge of ERP systems, Net Suite a plus
● Excellent client facing skills, including comfortability with all types of client communications.
● Prior speaker bureau experience a plus

title: Desenvolvedor front-end senior em alemanha (SE)
description:
Estamos construindo uma plataforma que transformará visibilidade em IA (GEO/AIO) em um produto mensurável, vendável e escalável para empresas e agências. E você poderá ser parte disso desde o início!
Buscamos um(a) Front-End Engineer que vá além da execução técnica — alguém que entenda que UX, SEO, GEO, performance e clareza de dados são diferenciais competitivos diretos .
Você será responsável por construir e evoluir toda a interface da plataforma: dashboards analíticos, módulos de GEO/AIO, relatórios white-label e um painel multi-cliente para agências.
O que você vai fazer
Desenvolver e evoluir o front-end da plataforma com React + Type Script, com foco em performance e escalabilidade
Construir dashboards analíticos complexos com dados em tempo real (GEO, AIO, GA4, GSC)
Implementar o painel multi-cliente white-label (Operator, Growth, Authority)
Trabalhar em conjunto com Design para garantir consistência e fidelidade ao Design System
Integrar APIs REST, Graph QL e streams de dados (LLMs via Web Sockets / SSE)
Otimizar performance (Core Web Vitals, lazy loading, code splitting, bundle size)
Escrever testes (unitários e integração) e garantir qualidade de código
Participar de code reviews e ajudar a definir padrões técnicos
O que esperamos de você
Experiência sólida com React + Type Script em produção
Domínio de gerenciamento de estado (Zustand, Redux Toolkit, React Query / Tan Stack Query)
Experiência com visualização de dados (Recharts, D3, Chart.js ou similares)
Experiência consumindo APIs REST (e idealmente Graph QL)
Conhecimento em CSS moderno (Tailwind, CSS Modules ou Styled Components)
Experiência com Git (PRs, code review, CI/CD)
Capacidade de pensar produto: questionar fluxos, simplificar interfaces e priorizar clareza
Diferenciais
Experiência com Saa S B2 B (especialmente marketing / SEO / analytics)
Experiência com Next.js (SSR / SSG)
Experiência com streaming de dados de IA (Web Sockets / SSE)
Construção ou manutenção de Design Systems
Familiaridade com GA4, GSC e Big Query
O que oferecemos
Ambiente de construção real (0 → 1)
Você vai participar diretamente da construção de um produto que está definindo uma nova categoria: GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)
Alto impacto no produto e decisões
Aqui você não é só executor — você influencia roadmap, arquitetura e decisões estratégicas
Contato direto com fundadores e visão de negócio
Você vai entender o porquê das decisões, não só o como
Compensação competitiva + upside (quando aplicável)
Salário competitivo + possibilidade de participação futura (equity/bonus baseado em performance)

title: Senior business analyst (healthcare marketing) em três lagoas (PI)
description:
One of our clients, a USA Healthcare Commercialization firm, is looking for a Senior Business Analyst with experience in SOWs and Project Finance. This role would be focused on their Speaker Bureau operations (organization of medical conferences and congresses).
The Sr. Business Analyst is responsible for managing financial and operational aspects of assigned clients and their products. This role requires a high level of understanding of the assigned clients and products, various speaker bureau project types, and the ability to work independently.
The Sr. Business Analyst works closely with the Director and financial analysts to ensure accurate internal and external financial reporting, develop budget proposals and provide financial related support in client meetings.
Financial
● Oversee day-to-day financial operations for speaker bureau, including budget tracking, internal revenue accruals, forecasting and variance analysis.
● Develops Statement of Work (SOW), ensuring final sign-off by Director as required.
● Create and manage budgets and proposals, providing oversight for complex SOWs. Prepare speaker bureau specific budgets, accrual reports and monthly financial management updates
● Work closely with program directors on monthly accrual reports, reviewing and discussing as needed.
● Ensure accuracy in financial reconciliation data before releasing reports to clients
● Generate and distribute monthly accruals and budget reports for clients
● Provide invoicing amounts to Accounts Receivable to facilitate timely invoice submissions
Operational
● Ensures compliance with internal Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and client specific SOPs.
● Provides budget related support in client meetings as needed.
● Participates in accrual meetings with clients based on their SOPs.
● Contributes to process improvement initiatives to enhance financial operations.
Experience and Skills
● 2+ Years experience in budgeting · Proficiency in Excel functions for financial modeling and analysis.
● Strong financial analysis skills, including budget tracking, forecasting and variance analysis · Excellent understanding of internal SOPs and ability to ensure compliance
● Familiar with all internal and external SOPs.
● Strives to find process efficiencies by thinking outside the box and making recommendations for change.
● Knowledge of ERP systems, Net Suite a plus
● Excellent client facing skills, including comfortability with all types of client communications.
● Prior speaker bureau experience a plus

title: Senior data engineer em belo horizonte (RN)
description:
Who We Are: We are a fast growing business and technology consultant company co-founded in 2019. We offer a custom-tailored, white-glove engineering service fit for our clients, because a digital transformation is more than just technology. With a successful track record of being a preferred vendor for Fortune 500 companies and as a trusted partner for some of the industry’s leading companies, our global talent has helped many clients achieve their goals.
The 3 G’s of RE:
“Get Shit Done.”
“Get Over Shit.”
“Give a Shit.”
What You’ll Do:
Design and build Spark data ETL pipelines on AWS data platform.
Collaborate with cross functional teams such as data scientists, fraud, marketing and other business stakeholders to understand their data needs and deliver reliable solutions.
Optimize data infrastructure - Design and maintain robust data infrastructure by using modern data platform architecture.
Ensure data quality and reliability.
Innovate and follow best practices.
Ensure operational excellence of the data platform, including monitoring, incident response, performance optimization, and continuous improvement.
Who We’re Looking For:
Professional experience working in data warehousing, data architecture, and/or data engineering environments, especially using spark, hadoop, hive etc with solid understanding of streaming pipelines.
Proficiency in at least one high-level programming language (Scala, Java, Python or equivalent)
Good understanding of databases
You have built large-scale data products and understand the tradeoffs made when building these features
You have a deep understanding of system design, data structures, and algorithms
You have an excellent knowledge of distributed computing frameworks such as Hadoop Map Reduce, Spark

You have strong understanding of data quality, governance
You are a team player, self-driven, highly motivated individual who loves to learn new things
Join Our Global Team: We invite you to apply for the position at RE Partners. Join us in shaping the future of business technology consulting and transforming the way organizations thrive in a digital world. As a diverse, woman-owned global business, we pride ourselves on keeping talent happy – our 7% attrition rate speaks volumes. Bring your talented friends along and earn a referral bonus
Equal Opportunity Employer: We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from all qualified individuals regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

title: Platform engineer / devops engineer em petrópolis (RN)
description:
Job Title: Platform Engineer / Dev Ops Engineer
Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)
Contract Duration: 12+ months with extensions
Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)
Work Hours: EST
Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)
Overview
We’re hiring a hands-on Platform / Dev Ops Engineer to join a small, high-impact platform team. This is a “boots-on-the-ground” execution role —not advisory—focused on building, operating, and improving the infrastructure and tooling that enables 100–150 engineers to ship code efficiently and reliably.
You’ll work closely with a lean team (Principal + Senior Engineers) and play a critical role in day-to-day platform operations, automation, and developer enablement .
What You’ll Do
Operate and improve platform tools to support engineering teams (triaging tickets, resolving build issues, handling access/secrets/env setup)
Manage Kubernetes environments : deployments, Helm charts, namespaces, rollout troubleshooting Support and enhance CI/CD pipelines (Git Lab CI preferred; Jenkins/Git Hub Actions acceptable) Maintain and improve self-service workflows , templates, and developer “golden paths” Work with observability tools ( Prometheus, Alertmanager, Thanos, Open Telemetry ) to monitor systems and improve signal quality Assist with service instrumentation across logging, metrics, and tracing Contribute to documentation: runbooks, onboarding guides, SOPs
Participate in on-call rotation and support incident response Optimize infrastructure for cost, performance, and reliability Automate repetitive tasks using scripting (Python/Bash)
Must-Have Requirements 6+ years in Platform Engineering / Dev Ops / SRE / Infrastructure roles Strong AWS experience (IAM, EC2/EKS, S3, Cloud Watch, etc.) Deep Kubernetes expertise : Operating and maintaining clusters
Experience building Kubernetes environments
Hands-on Terraform (Infrastructure as Code) Python scripting (mandatory) for automation and tooling Experience owning and maintaining CI/CD pipelines Strong Linux fundamentals Solid understanding of observability concepts (metrics, logs, tracing)
Preferred Qualifications Experience with Git Lab CI Exposure to Open Telemetry API integration or tooling development (Python/Go/Java)
Experience supporting large engineering teams (100+ developers) Familiarity with security in CI/CD or infrastructure workflows Multi-cloud exposure (Azure/GCP alongside AWS)
Background in mid-size, modern engineering organizations
What We’re NOT Looking For
No Kubernetes experience ❌
Bash-only engineers (no Python) ❌
Pure consulting/advisory profiles ❌
Pure security-focused candidates ❌
Heavy enterprise/banking-only backgrounds ❌
ML/Data Science profiles ❌
Team Structure
1 Principal Engineer
1 Senior Engineer
1 Engineer (India)
You = 4th key team member

title: Commercial lead — brazil em manaus (MA)
description:
About Regrow
Regrow is a climate-tech company on a mission to make resilient agriculture the global norm. We partner with food, beverage, textile, and financial sector leaders to measure, reduce, and report on the environmental impact of their agricultural supply chains. Our platform combines agronomic science, remote sensing, and data analytics to help organizations meet their sustainability goals while supporting farmers through the transition to regenerative practices.

About the Role
As Commercial Lead in Brazil, you will drive Regrow’s commercial growth in one of our most strategic markets. This is a full-cycle, new-business role: you will open new accounts, build and qualify pipeline, and close enterprise deals with customers across Brazil’s agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.
You will work closely with our Head of Lat Am, global go-to-market team, and customer success organization to bring Regrow’s platform to food and beverage brands, textile companies, biofuel producers, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, traders, banks, and financial institutions operating across grains, beef, and dairy value chains.
This is a plug-and-play role for a senior commercial professional who brings an established network and deep sector understanding. You will act as a market-opening engine, converting your credibility and relationships into new logos and meaningful ARR growth.

What You’ll Do
Own the full commercial cycle for new business in Brazil: prospecting, discovery, qualification, proposal, negotiation, and close.
Open doors with senior decision-makers and executive sponsors at strategic target accounts.
Build and maintain a qualified pipeline sourced exclusively from new accounts, with disciplined CRM hygiene and accurate forecasting.
Expand Regrow’s presence in priority verticals, including CPG, textiles, biofuels, agribusiness, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, and financial institutions.
Position Regrow credibly within Brazil’s grains, beef, and dairy value chains, adapting our narrative to local market context.
Partner with global GTM, product, science, and customer success teams to shape complex deals and ensure smooth post-close transitions.
Provide structured market intelligence on competitive dynamics, buyer needs, adoption barriers, and regulatory signals.
Represent Regrow at industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.
What You’ll Bring
Proven experience in hunting and opening new enterprise accounts in complex B2 B environments.
Track record of closing new business and an active network that can be activated in the short term.
Strong presence in agribusiness with real access to decision-makers across agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.
Deep understanding of Brazilian agri-food ecosystems and buyers such as CPGs, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, banks, and financial institutions.
Experience in or strong affinity with climate tech, sustainability, regenerative agriculture, carbon footprint, MRV, traceability, or Saa S platforms.
Executive presence and the credibility to engage senior buyers as a commercial partner, not a transactional seller.
Ability to translate technical and scientific topics into clear, concrete commercial proposals.
Comfort operating in a matrixed environment with global teams and in dynamic, high-growth contexts.
Native or near-native Portuguese fluency.
Professional working proficiency in English, with the ability to present to and collaborate with global stakeholders regularly.
Willingness to travel as needed for industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.
Nice to Have
Recent experience in scale-ups, startups, or high-growth technology companies.
Experience selling innovative categories into traditional industries.
Working knowledge of Spanish.
Why Regrow
Meaningful mission: shape the future of agriculture and help build climate resilience at scale.
High-growth, scale-up environment with autonomy and real ownership.
A collaborative global team combining commercial, scientific, and technical expertise.
Competitive compensation and benefits.
 
Acerca de Regrow
Regrow es una empresa de climate tech con la misión de convertir la agricultura resiliente en la norma global. Trabajamos con líderes de los sectores alimentario, de bebidas, textil y financiero para medir, reducir y reportar el impacto ambiental de sus cadenas de suministro agrícolas. Nuestra plataforma combina ciencia agronómica, sensores remotos y analítica de datos para ayudar a las organizaciones a alcanzar sus objetivos de sostenibilidad, apoyando al mismo tiempo a los productores en la transición hacia prácticas regenerativas.
Sobre el Rol
Como Commercial Lead — Brasil, impulsarás el crecimiento comercial de Regrow en uno de nuestros mercados más estratégicos. Este es un rol de ciclo completo enfocado en nuevos negocios: abrirás nuevas cuentas, construirás y calificarás pipeline, y cerrarás acuerdos enterprise con clientes a lo largo de las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial de Brasil.
Trabajarás en estrecha colaboración con nuestra Directora de Lat Am, el equipo global de go-to-market y la organización de customer success para llevar la plataforma de Regrow a marcas de alimentos y bebidas, empresas textiles, productores de biocombustibles, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, traders, bancos e instituciones financieras que operan en las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos.
Este es un rol plug-and-play para un profesional comercial senior que aporte una red establecida y un profundo conocimiento sectorial. Actuarás como motor de apertura de mercado, convirtiendo tu credibilidad y relaciones en nuevos logos y crecimiento significativo de ARR.
Qué Harás
Serás dueño del ciclo comercial completo de nuevos negocios en Brasil: prospección, descubrimiento, calificación, propuesta, negociación y cierre.
Abrirás puertas con tomadores de decisiones senior y sponsors ejecutivos en cuentas objetivo estratégicas.
Construirás y mantendrás un pipeline calificado proveniente exclusivamente de nuevas cuentas, con disciplina en CRM y precisión en el forecast.
Expandirás la presencia de Regrow en verticales prioritarias: CPG, textiles, biocombustibles, agronegocios, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos e instituciones financieras.
Posicionarás a Regrow con credibilidad dentro de las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos de Brasil, adaptando nuestra narrativa al contexto local.
Colaborarás con los equipos globales de GTM, producto, ciencia y customer success para estructurar acuerdos complejos y asegurar transiciones post-cierre fluidas.
Proporcionarás inteligencia estructurada de mercado sobre dinámicas competitivas, necesidades de compradores, barreras de adopción y señales regulatorias.
Representarás a Regrow en conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.
Qué Aportarás
Experiencia comprobada en hunting y apertura de nuevas cuentas enterprise en entornos B2 B complejos.
Historial de cierre de nuevos negocios y una red activa que pueda ser activada en el corto plazo.
Fuerte presencia en agronegocios con acceso real a tomadores de decisiones en las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial.
Comprensión profunda de los ecosistemas agroalimentarios brasileños y de compradores como CPGs, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, bancos e instituciones financieras.
Experiencia en o fuerte afinidad con climate tech, sostenibilidad, agricultura regenerativa, huella de carbono, MRV, trazabilidad o plataformas Saa S.
Presencia ejecutiva y credibilidad para relacionarse con compradores senior como socio comercial, no como vendedor transaccional.
Capacidad para traducir temas técnicos y científicos en propuestas comerciales claras y concretas.
Comodidad operando en un entorno matricial con equipos globales y en contextos dinámicos de alto crecimiento.
Dominio nativo o casi nativo del portugués.
Dominio profesional del inglés, con capacidad para presentar y colaborar con stakeholders globales de manera regular.
Disponibilidad para viajar según sea necesario para conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.
Deseable
Experiencia reciente en scale-ups, startups o empresas de tecnología de alto crecimiento.
Experiencia vendiendo categorías innovadoras a industrias tradicionales.
Conocimiento funcional del español.
Por Qué Regrow
Misión con propósito: dar forma al futuro de la agricultura y contribuir a construir resiliencia climática a escala.
Entorno de alto crecimiento tipo scale-up con autonomía y responsabilidad real.
Un equipo global colaborativo que combina experiencia comercial, científica y técnica.
Compensación y beneficios competitivos.

title: Commercial lead — brazil em cuiabá (SE)
description:
About Regrow
Regrow is a climate-tech company on a mission to make resilient agriculture the global norm. We partner with food, beverage, textile, and financial sector leaders to measure, reduce, and report on the environmental impact of their agricultural supply chains. Our platform combines agronomic science, remote sensing, and data analytics to help organizations meet their sustainability goals while supporting farmers through the transition to regenerative practices.

About the Role
As Commercial Lead in Brazil, you will drive Regrow’s commercial growth in one of our most strategic markets. This is a full-cycle, new-business role: you will open new accounts, build and qualify pipeline, and close enterprise deals with customers across Brazil’s agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.
You will work closely with our Head of Lat Am, global go-to-market team, and customer success organization to bring Regrow’s platform to food and beverage brands, textile companies, biofuel producers, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, traders, banks, and financial institutions operating across grains, beef, and dairy value chains.
This is a plug-and-play role for a senior commercial professional who brings an established network and deep sector understanding. You will act as a market-opening engine, converting your credibility and relationships into new logos and meaningful ARR growth.

What You’ll Do
Own the full commercial cycle for new business in Brazil: prospecting, discovery, qualification, proposal, negotiation, and close.
Open doors with senior decision-makers and executive sponsors at strategic target accounts.
Build and maintain a qualified pipeline sourced exclusively from new accounts, with disciplined CRM hygiene and accurate forecasting.
Expand Regrow’s presence in priority verticals, including CPG, textiles, biofuels, agribusiness, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, and financial institutions.
Position Regrow credibly within Brazil’s grains, beef, and dairy value chains, adapting our narrative to local market context.
Partner with global GTM, product, science, and customer success teams to shape complex deals and ensure smooth post-close transitions.
Provide structured market intelligence on competitive dynamics, buyer needs, adoption barriers, and regulatory signals.
Represent Regrow at industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.
What You’ll Bring
Proven experience in hunting and opening new enterprise accounts in complex B2 B environments.
Track record of closing new business and an active network that can be activated in the short term.
Strong presence in agribusiness with real access to decision-makers across agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.
Deep understanding of Brazilian agri-food ecosystems and buyers such as CPGs, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, banks, and financial institutions.
Experience in or strong affinity with climate tech, sustainability, regenerative agriculture, carbon footprint, MRV, traceability, or Saa S platforms.
Executive presence and the credibility to engage senior buyers as a commercial partner, not a transactional seller.
Ability to translate technical and scientific topics into clear, concrete commercial proposals.
Comfort operating in a matrixed environment with global teams and in dynamic, high-growth contexts.
Native or near-native Portuguese fluency.
Professional working proficiency in English, with the ability to present to and collaborate with global stakeholders regularly.
Willingness to travel as needed for industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.
Nice to Have
Recent experience in scale-ups, startups, or high-growth technology companies.
Experience selling innovative categories into traditional industries.
Working knowledge of Spanish.
Why Regrow
Meaningful mission: shape the future of agriculture and help build climate resilience at scale.
High-growth, scale-up environment with autonomy and real ownership.
A collaborative global team combining commercial, scientific, and technical expertise.
Competitive compensation and benefits.
 
Acerca de Regrow
Regrow es una empresa de climate tech con la misión de convertir la agricultura resiliente en la norma global. Trabajamos con líderes de los sectores alimentario, de bebidas, textil y financiero para medir, reducir y reportar el impacto ambiental de sus cadenas de suministro agrícolas. Nuestra plataforma combina ciencia agronómica, sensores remotos y analítica de datos para ayudar a las organizaciones a alcanzar sus objetivos de sostenibilidad, apoyando al mismo tiempo a los productores en la transición hacia prácticas regenerativas.
Sobre el Rol
Como Commercial Lead — Brasil, impulsarás el crecimiento comercial de Regrow en uno de nuestros mercados más estratégicos. Este es un rol de ciclo completo enfocado en nuevos negocios: abrirás nuevas cuentas, construirás y calificarás pipeline, y cerrarás acuerdos enterprise con clientes a lo largo de las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial de Brasil.
Trabajarás en estrecha colaboración con nuestra Directora de Lat Am, el equipo global de go-to-market y la organización de customer success para llevar la plataforma de Regrow a marcas de alimentos y bebidas, empresas textiles, productores de biocombustibles, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, traders, bancos e instituciones financieras que operan en las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos.
Este es un rol plug-and-play para un profesional comercial senior que aporte una red establecida y un profundo conocimiento sectorial. Actuarás como motor de apertura de mercado, convirtiendo tu credibilidad y relaciones en nuevos logos y crecimiento significativo de ARR.
Qué Harás
Serás dueño del ciclo comercial completo de nuevos negocios en Brasil: prospección, descubrimiento, calificación, propuesta, negociación y cierre.
Abrirás puertas con tomadores de decisiones senior y sponsors ejecutivos en cuentas objetivo estratégicas.
Construirás y mantendrás un pipeline calificado proveniente exclusivamente de nuevas cuentas, con disciplina en CRM y precisión en el forecast.
Expandirás la presencia de Regrow en verticales prioritarias: CPG, textiles, biocombustibles, agronegocios, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos e instituciones financieras.
Posicionarás a Regrow con credibilidad dentro de las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos de Brasil, adaptando nuestra narrativa al contexto local.
Colaborarás con los equipos globales de GTM, producto, ciencia y customer success para estructurar acuerdos complejos y asegurar transiciones post-cierre fluidas.
Proporcionarás inteligencia estructurada de mercado sobre dinámicas competitivas, necesidades de compradores, barreras de adopción y señales regulatorias.
Representarás a Regrow en conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.
Qué Aportarás
Experiencia comprobada en hunting y apertura de nuevas cuentas enterprise en entornos B2 B complejos.
Historial de cierre de nuevos negocios y una red activa que pueda ser activada en el corto plazo.
Fuerte presencia en agronegocios con acceso real a tomadores de decisiones en las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial.
Comprensión profunda de los ecosistemas agroalimentarios brasileños y de compradores como CPGs, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, bancos e instituciones financieras.
Experiencia en o fuerte afinidad con climate tech, sostenibilidad, agricultura regenerativa, huella de carbono, MRV, trazabilidad o plataformas Saa S.
Presencia ejecutiva y credibilidad para relacionarse con compradores senior como socio comercial, no como vendedor transaccional.
Capacidad para traducir temas técnicos y científicos en propuestas comerciales claras y concretas.
Comodidad operando en un entorno matricial con equipos globales y en contextos dinámicos de alto crecimiento.
Dominio nativo o casi nativo del portugués.
Dominio profesional del inglés, con capacidad para presentar y colaborar con stakeholders globales de manera regular.
Disponibilidad para viajar según sea necesario para conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.
Deseable
Experiencia reciente en scale-ups, startups o empresas de tecnología de alto crecimiento.
Experiencia vendiendo categorías innovadoras a industrias tradicionales.
Conocimiento funcional del español.
Por Qué Regrow
Misión con propósito: dar forma al futuro de la agricultura y contribuir a construir resiliencia climática a escala.
Entorno de alto crecimiento tipo scale-up con autonomía y responsabilidad real.
Un equipo global colaborativo que combina experiencia comercial, científica y técnica.
Compensación y beneficios competitivos.

title: Commercial lead — brazil em são paulo (RN)
description:
About Regrow
Regrow is a climate-tech company on a mission to make resilient agriculture the global norm. We partner with food, beverage, textile, and financial sector leaders to measure, reduce, and report on the environmental impact of their agricultural supply chains. Our platform combines agronomic science, remote sensing, and data analytics to help organizations meet their sustainability goals while supporting farmers through the transition to regenerative practices.

About the Role
As Commercial Lead in Brazil, you will drive Regrow’s commercial growth in one of our most strategic markets. This is a full-cycle, new-business role: you will open new accounts, build and qualify pipeline, and close enterprise deals with customers across Brazil’s agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.
You will work closely with our Head of Lat Am, global go-to-market team, and customer success organization to bring Regrow’s platform to food and beverage brands, textile companies, biofuel producers, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, traders, banks, and financial institutions operating across grains, beef, and dairy value chains.
This is a plug-and-play role for a senior commercial professional who brings an established network and deep sector understanding. You will act as a market-opening engine, converting your credibility and relationships into new logos and meaningful ARR growth.

What You’ll Do
Own the full commercial cycle for new business in Brazil: prospecting, discovery, qualification, proposal, negotiation, and close.
Open doors with senior decision-makers and executive sponsors at strategic target accounts.
Build and maintain a qualified pipeline sourced exclusively from new accounts, with disciplined CRM hygiene and accurate forecasting.
Expand Regrow’s presence in priority verticals, including CPG, textiles, biofuels, agribusiness, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, and financial institutions.
Position Regrow credibly within Brazil’s grains, beef, and dairy value chains, adapting our narrative to local market context.
Partner with global GTM, product, science, and customer success teams to shape complex deals and ensure smooth post-close transitions.
Provide structured market intelligence on competitive dynamics, buyer needs, adoption barriers, and regulatory signals.
Represent Regrow at industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.
What You’ll Bring
Proven experience in hunting and opening new enterprise accounts in complex B2 B environments.
Track record of closing new business and an active network that can be activated in the short term.
Strong presence in agribusiness with real access to decision-makers across agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.
Deep understanding of Brazilian agri-food ecosystems and buyers such as CPGs, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, banks, and financial institutions.
Experience in or strong affinity with climate tech, sustainability, regenerative agriculture, carbon footprint, MRV, traceability, or Saa S platforms.
Executive presence and the credibility to engage senior buyers as a commercial partner, not a transactional seller.
Ability to translate technical and scientific topics into clear, concrete commercial proposals.
Comfort operating in a matrixed environment with global teams and in dynamic, high-growth contexts.
Native or near-native Portuguese fluency.
Professional working proficiency in English, with the ability to present to and collaborate with global stakeholders regularly.
Willingness to travel as needed for industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.
Nice to Have
Recent experience in scale-ups, startups, or high-growth technology companies.
Experience selling innovative categories into traditional industries.
Working knowledge of Spanish.
Why Regrow
Meaningful mission: shape the future of agriculture and help build climate resilience at scale.
High-growth, scale-up environment with autonomy and real ownership.
A collaborative global team combining commercial, scientific, and technical expertise.
Competitive compensation and benefits.
 
Acerca de Regrow
Regrow es una empresa de climate tech con la misión de convertir la agricultura resiliente en la norma global. Trabajamos con líderes de los sectores alimentario, de bebidas, textil y financiero para medir, reducir y reportar el impacto ambiental de sus cadenas de suministro agrícolas. Nuestra plataforma combina ciencia agronómica, sensores remotos y analítica de datos para ayudar a las organizaciones a alcanzar sus objetivos de sostenibilidad, apoyando al mismo tiempo a los productores en la transición hacia prácticas regenerativas.
Sobre el Rol
Como Commercial Lead — Brasil, impulsarás el crecimiento comercial de Regrow en uno de nuestros mercados más estratégicos. Este es un rol de ciclo completo enfocado en nuevos negocios: abrirás nuevas cuentas, construirás y calificarás pipeline, y cerrarás acuerdos enterprise con clientes a lo largo de las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial de Brasil.
Trabajarás en estrecha colaboración con nuestra Directora de Lat Am, el equipo global de go-to-market y la organización de customer success para llevar la plataforma de Regrow a marcas de alimentos y bebidas, empresas textiles, productores de biocombustibles, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, traders, bancos e instituciones financieras que operan en las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos.
Este es un rol plug-and-play para un profesional comercial senior que aporte una red establecida y un profundo conocimiento sectorial. Actuarás como motor de apertura de mercado, convirtiendo tu credibilidad y relaciones en nuevos logos y crecimiento significativo de ARR.

Abrirás puertas con tomadores de decisiones senior y sponsors ejecutivos en cuentas objetivo estratégicas.
Construirás y mantendrás un pipeline calificado proveniente exclusivamente de nuevas cuentas, con disciplina en CRM y precisión en el forecast.
Expandirás la presencia de Regrow en verticales prioritarias: CPG, textiles, biocombustibles, agronegocios, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos e instituciones financieras.
Posicionarás a Regrow con credibilidad dentro de las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos de Brasil, adaptando nuestra narrativa al contexto local.
Colaborarás con los equipos globales de GTM, producto, ciencia y customer success para estructurar acuerdos complejos y asegurar transiciones post-cierre fluidas.
Proporcionarás inteligencia estructurada de mercado sobre dinámicas competitivas, necesidades de compradores, barreras de adopción y señales regulatorias.
Representarás a Regrow en conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.
Qué Aportarás
Experiencia comprobada en hunting y apertura de nuevas cuentas enterprise en entornos B2 B complejos.
Historial de cierre de nuevos negocios y una red activa que pueda ser activada en el corto plazo.
Fuerte presencia en agronegocios con acceso real a tomadores de decisiones en las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial.
Comprensión profunda de los ecosistemas agroalimentarios brasileños y de compradores como CPGs, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, bancos e instituciones financieras.
Experiencia en o fuerte afinidad con climate tech, sostenibilidad, agricultura regenerativa, huella de carbono, MRV, trazabilidad o plataformas Saa S.
Presencia ejecutiva y credibilidad para relacionarse con compradores senior como socio comercial, no como vendedor transaccional.
Capacidad para traducir temas técnicos y científicos en propuestas comerciales claras y concretas.
Comodidad operando en un entorno matricial con equipos globales y en contextos dinámicos de alto crecimiento.
Dominio nativo o casi nativo del portugués.
Dominio profesional del inglés, con capacidad para presentar y colaborar con stakeholders globales de manera regular.
Disponibilidad para viajar según sea necesario para conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.
Deseable
Experiencia reciente en scale-ups, startups o empresas de tecnología de alto crecimiento.
Experiencia vendiendo categorías innovadoras a industrias tradicionales.
Conocimiento funcional del español.
Por Qué Regrow

Entorno de alto crecimiento tipo scale-up con autonomía y responsabilidad real.

title: Commercial lead — brazil em eusébio (CE)
description:
About Regrow
Regrow is a climate-tech company on a mission to make resilient agriculture the global norm. We partner with food, beverage, textile, and financial sector leaders to measure, reduce, and report on the environmental impact of their agricultural supply chains. Our platform combines agronomic science, remote sensing, and data analytics to help organizations meet their sustainability goals while supporting farmers through the transition to regenerative practices.

About the Role
As Commercial Lead in Brazil, you will drive Regrow’s commercial growth in one of our most strategic markets. This is a full-cycle, new-business role: you will open new accounts, build and qualify pipeline, and close enterprise deals with customers across Brazil’s agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.
You will work closely with our Head of Lat Am, global go-to-market team, and customer success organization to bring Regrow’s platform to food and beverage brands, textile companies, biofuel producers, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, traders, banks, and financial institutions operating across grains, beef, and dairy value chains.
This is a plug-and-play role for a senior commercial professional who brings an established network and deep sector understanding. You will act as a market-opening engine, converting your credibility and relationships into new logos and meaningful ARR growth.

What You’ll Do
Own the full commercial cycle for new business in Brazil: prospecting, discovery, qualification, proposal, negotiation, and close.
Open doors with senior decision-makers and executive sponsors at strategic target accounts.
Build and maintain a qualified pipeline sourced exclusively from new accounts, with disciplined CRM hygiene and accurate forecasting.
Expand Regrow’s presence in priority verticals, including CPG, textiles, biofuels, agribusiness, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, and financial institutions.
Position Regrow credibly within Brazil’s grains, beef, and dairy value chains, adapting our narrative to local market context.
Partner with global GTM, product, science, and customer success teams to shape complex deals and ensure smooth post-close transitions.
Provide structured market intelligence on competitive dynamics, buyer needs, adoption barriers, and regulatory signals.
Represent Regrow at industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.
What You’ll Bring
Proven experience in hunting and opening new enterprise accounts in complex B2 B environments.
Track record of closing new business and an active network that can be activated in the short term.
Strong presence in agribusiness with real access to decision-makers across agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.
Deep understanding of Brazilian agri-food ecosystems and buyers such as CPGs, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, banks, and financial institutions.
Experience in or strong affinity with climate tech, sustainability, regenerative agriculture, carbon footprint, MRV, traceability, or Saa S platforms.
Executive presence and the credibility to engage senior buyers as a commercial partner, not a transactional seller.
Ability to translate technical and scientific topics into clear, concrete commercial proposals.
Comfort operating in a matrixed environment with global teams and in dynamic, high-growth contexts.
Native or near-native Portuguese fluency.
Professional working proficiency in English, with the ability to present to and collaborate with global stakeholders regularly.
Willingness to travel as needed for industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.
Nice to Have
Recent experience in scale-ups, startups, or high-growth technology companies.
Experience selling innovative categories into traditional industries.
Working knowledge of Spanish.
Why Regrow
Meaningful mission: shape the future of agriculture and help build climate resilience at scale.
High-growth, scale-up environment with autonomy and real ownership.
A collaborative global team combining commercial, scientific, and technical expertise.
Competitive compensation and benefits.
 
Acerca de Regrow
Regrow es una empresa de climate tech con la misión de convertir la agricultura resiliente en la norma global. Trabajamos con líderes de los sectores alimentario, de bebidas, textil y financiero para medir, reducir y reportar el impacto ambiental de sus cadenas de suministro agrícolas. Nuestra plataforma combina ciencia agronómica, sensores remotos y analítica de datos para ayudar a las organizaciones a alcanzar sus objetivos de sostenibilidad, apoyando al mismo tiempo a los productores en la transición hacia prácticas regenerativas.
Sobre el Rol
Como Commercial Lead — Brasil, impulsarás el crecimiento comercial de Regrow en uno de nuestros mercados más estratégicos. Este es un rol de ciclo completo enfocado en nuevos negocios: abrirás nuevas cuentas, construirás y calificarás pipeline, y cerrarás acuerdos enterprise con clientes a lo largo de las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial de Brasil.
Trabajarás en estrecha colaboración con nuestra Directora de Lat Am, el equipo global de go-to-market y la organización de customer success para llevar la plataforma de Regrow a marcas de alimentos y bebidas, empresas textiles, productores de biocombustibles, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, traders, bancos e instituciones financieras que operan en las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos.
Este es un rol plug-and-play para un profesional comercial senior que aporte una red establecida y un profundo conocimiento sectorial. Actuarás como motor de apertura de mercado, convirtiendo tu credibilidad y relaciones en nuevos logos y crecimiento significativo de ARR.
Qué Harás
Serás dueño del ciclo comercial completo de nuevos negocios en Brasil: prospección, descubrimiento, calificación, propuesta, negociación y cierre.
Abrirás puertas con tomadores de decisiones senior y sponsors ejecutivos en cuentas objetivo estratégicas.
Construirás y mantendrás un pipeline calificado proveniente exclusivamente de nuevas cuentas, con disciplina en CRM y precisión en el forecast.
Expandirás la presencia de Regrow en verticales prioritarias: CPG, textiles, biocombustibles, agronegocios, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos e instituciones financieras.
Posicionarás a Regrow con credibilidad dentro de las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos de Brasil, adaptando nuestra narrativa al contexto local.
Colaborarás con los equipos globales de GTM, producto, ciencia y customer success para estructurar acuerdos complejos y asegurar transiciones post-cierre fluidas.
Proporcionarás inteligencia estructurada de mercado sobre dinámicas competitivas, necesidades de compradores, barreras de adopción y señales regulatorias.
Representarás a Regrow en conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.
Qué Aportarás
Experiencia comprobada en hunting y apertura de nuevas cuentas enterprise en entornos B2 B complejos.
Historial de cierre de nuevos negocios y una red activa que pueda ser activada en el corto plazo.
Fuerte presencia en agronegocios con acceso real a tomadores de decisiones en las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial.
Comprensión profunda de los ecosistemas agroalimentarios brasileños y de compradores como CPGs, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, bancos e instituciones financieras.
Experiencia en o fuerte afinidad con climate tech, sostenibilidad, agricultura regenerativa, huella de carbono, MRV, trazabilidad o plataformas Saa S.

Comodidad operando en un entorno matricial con equipos globales y en contextos dinámicos de alto crecimiento.
Dominio nativo o casi nativo del portugués.
Dominio profesional del inglés, con capacidad para presentar y colaborar con stakeholders globales de manera regular.
Disponibilidad para viajar según sea necesario para conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.

Experiencia reciente en scale-ups, startups o empresas de tecnología de alto crecimiento.
Experiencia vendiendo categorías innovadoras a industrias tradicionales.

Misión con propósito: dar forma al futuro de la agricultura y contribuir a construir resiliencia climática a escala.
Entorno de alto crecimiento tipo scale-up con autonomía y responsabilidad real.
