title: Digital marketing ad strategist em eusébio (CE)
description:
The Digital Marketing Ad Strategist is a responsible for the performance, health, and scalability of paid advertising accounts across Google Ads, Meta (Facebook & Instagram), and Linked In Ads. This role is heavily focused on account audits, ongoing optimization, technical troubleshooting, and performance improvements.
You will analyze existing ad accounts, identify inefficiencies and technical issues, recommend and implement fixes, and ensure tracking, structure, and strategy are aligned with business objectives.
Requirements
In-depth knowledge of the following platforms: Google ads, Facebook Ads, Microsoft Ads
Detail oriented
Key Responsibilities
Account Audits & Diagnostics
 • Conduct in-depth audits of Google Ads, Meta, Microsoft, and Linked In Ads accounts. Experience or working knowledge across secondary platforms, including Tik Tok, Pinterest, Reddit, X, Snapchat, Spotify, and Amazon.
 • Identify structural issues, wasted spend, tracking gaps, and performance blockers
 • Diagnose bugs and technical issues such as:
 • Incorrect or missing conversion tracking
 • Pixel or tag misfires
 • Attribution and reporting discrepancies
 • Budget pacing and delivery issues
 • Audience overlap and campaign cannibalization
 • Document findings and deliver clear, prioritized optimization recommendations
 Optimization & Performance Management
  • Continuous proactive optimization of campaigns, ad groups, keywords, audiences, bids, and creatives
 • Improve key performance metrics such as CPA, ROAS, CTR, and conversion rate
 • Manage and reallocate budgets based on performance and growth opportunities
 • Plan and execute A/B tests across targeting, creative, offers, and landing pages
 • Optimize accounts across full-funnel stages (awareness, consideration, conversion)
 Strategy & Execution
 • Translate business goals into effective paid media strategies
 • Ensure account structures align with funnel intent and buyer journeys
 • Align ad messaging with audience intent and platform best practices
 Tracking, Data & Reporting
 • Ensure accurate setup and ongoing validation of conversion tracking
 • Work with GA4, Google Tag Manager, and platform analytics to confirm data integrity
 • Analyze performance data to uncover insights, issues, and opportunities
 • Create performance reports that clearly explain results, risks, and next steps
 Process & Quality Control
  • Maintain clean account structure, naming conventions, and documentation
 • Build and follow optimization and audit checklists
 • Stay current on platform updates, policy changes, and best practices
 • Proactively flag risks, inefficiencies, or declining performance trends
Additional Tasks
 • Forecasts and initial ad spend recommendations to assist with the Sales team.
 • Have basic design knowledge and be able to coordinate ad copy and creative with internal team members.
Language Requirements
 • Fluent in English and Portuguese
Salary
$3000 BRL (Brazilian Real) / Per Month to start
Benefits after 6 months
Hiring Process:
Initial Interview with small knowledge test
Second interview with Ads team
Possible follow up questions / test
Final meet and greet meeting

title: Sr. compliance onboarding specialist em aracaju (SE)
description:
About the Role
We are looking for a highly motivated and detail-oriented Senior Compliance Onboarding Specialist to join our growing team at Velafi. In this role, you will be instrumental in managing and enhancing the onboarding and KYC (Know Your Customer) processes for our clients across multiple jurisdictions, with a strong focus on Brazil and Latin America.
You will collaborate closely with Sales, Operations, and Compliance teams to design efficient, scalable onboarding frameworks that deliver a seamless customer experience while maintaining strict adherence to regulatory requirements. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced fintech environment and is passionate about balancing compliance excellence with business enablement.
Key Responsibilities

Contribute to the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of onboarding controls, policies, and procedures to ensure efficiency, scalability, and regulatory compliance.
Act as the subject matter expert for onboarding clients operating in Brazil, ensuring alignment with Brazilian local AML/CTF regulations and industry best practices.
Perform detailed reviews and analysis of B2 B customer documentation, including Customer Risk Assessments and Customer Due Diligence to support informed onboarding decisions.
Partner with Sales, Operations, and other internal stakeholders to provide clear guidance on compliance requirements, enabling smooth client onboarding and expansion into new markets. Advise internal teams on AML risks and regulatory considerations when entering new industries or geographic regions.
Conduct background checks, adverse media screenings, and ongoing monitoring of clients and prospects to identify and mitigate potential risks.
Support the Compliance function in applying regulatory frameworks across LATAM jurisdictions, ensuring compliant operations in Brazil matters.
What We’re Looking For

Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field, with a strong foundation in Compliance.
3+ years of hands-on experience in Compliance, preferably within fintech, digital banking, payments, or financial services environments.
Strong knowledge of KYC, AML, CDD, and CRA frameworks
Solid understanding of Brazilian AML/CTF regulations
Familiarity with international regulatory standards, including BSA, USA PATRIOT Act, and OFAC
Ability to evaluate complex customer structures, identify risks, and make sound compliance decisions.
Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to work cross-functionally and communicate complex regulatory concepts clearly.
Fluent in Spanish (English is a strong plus).
Proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable operating in a dynamic, fast-growing environment with evolving regulatory landscapes.

description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.
Overview of the role
The Risk & Governance Analyst position involves establishing and overseeing the IT governance framework to mitigate operational risks and ensure regulatory compliance, providing strategic metrics that facilitate informed decision-making by senior management. As the strategic architect behind technology's safety and compliance, your mission is to bridge the gap between complex technical operations and business objectives by identifying potential threats before they materialize. You'll build a culture of risk awareness, ensuring IT infrastructure remains resilient, compliant, and aligned with international standards like ISO 27001 and COBIT.

- Following up with risk owners and business areas to obtain status updates and evidence.
- Consolidating, measuring, and communicating monthly KPIs for IT teams.
- Ensuring that periodic reviews include open, in-progress, and closed risks.
- Supporting risk reporting and governance communication to management.

Regrow is a climate-tech company on a mission to make resilient agriculture the global norm. We partner with food, beverage, textile, and financial sector leaders to measure, reduce, and report on the environmental impact of their agricultural supply chains. Our platform combines agronomic science, remote sensing, and data analytics to help organizations meet their sustainability goals while supporting farmers through the transition to regenerative practices.

As Commercial Lead in Brazil, you will drive Regrow’s commercial growth in one of our most strategic markets. This is a full-cycle, new-business role: you will open new accounts, build and qualify pipeline, and close enterprise deals with customers across Brazil’s agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.

Open doors with senior decision-makers and executive sponsors at strategic target accounts.

Partner with global GTM, product, science, and customer success teams to shape complex deals and ensure smooth post-close transitions.
Provide structured market intelligence on competitive dynamics, buyer needs, adoption barriers, and regulatory signals.
Represent Regrow at industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.

Strong presence in agribusiness with real access to decision-makers across agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.

Recent experience in scale-ups, startups, or high-growth technology companies.
Experience selling innovative categories into traditional industries.
Working knowledge of Spanish.
Why Regrow
Meaningful mission: shape the future of agriculture and help build climate resilience at scale.
High-growth, scale-up environment with autonomy and real ownership.
A collaborative global team combining commercial, scientific, and technical expertise.
Competitive compensation and benefits.
 
Acerca de Regrow
Regrow es una empresa de climate tech con la misión de convertir la agricultura resiliente en la norma global. Trabajamos con líderes de los sectores alimentario, de bebidas, textil y financiero para medir, reducir y reportar el impacto ambiental de sus cadenas de suministro agrícolas. Nuestra plataforma combina ciencia agronómica, sensores remotos y analítica de datos para ayudar a las organizaciones a alcanzar sus objetivos de sostenibilidad, apoyando al mismo tiempo a los productores en la transición hacia prácticas regenerativas.

Como Commercial Lead — Brasil, impulsarás el crecimiento comercial de Regrow en uno de nuestros mercados más estratégicos. Este es un rol de ciclo completo enfocado en nuevos negocios: abrirás nuevas cuentas, construirás y calificarás pipeline, y cerrarás acuerdos enterprise con clientes a lo largo de las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial de Brasil.
Trabajarás en estrecha colaboración con nuestra Directora de Lat Am, el equipo global de go-to-market y la organización de customer success para llevar la plataforma de Regrow a marcas de alimentos y bebidas, empresas textiles, productores de biocombustibles, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, traders, bancos e instituciones financieras que operan en las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos.

Posicionarás a Regrow con credibilidad dentro de las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos de Brasil, adaptando nuestra narrativa al contexto local.
Colaborarás con los equipos globales de GTM, producto, ciencia y customer success para estructurar acuerdos complejos y asegurar transiciones post-cierre fluidas.
Proporcionarás inteligencia estructurada de mercado sobre dinámicas competitivas, necesidades de compradores, barreras de adopción y señales regulatorias.
Representarás a Regrow en conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.

Historial de cierre de nuevos negocios y una red activa que pueda ser activada en el corto plazo.

Comprensión profunda de los ecosistemas agroalimentarios brasileños y de compradores como CPGs, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, bancos e instituciones financieras.
Experiencia en o fuerte afinidad con climate tech, sostenibilidad, agricultura regenerativa, huella de carbono, MRV, trazabilidad o plataformas Saa S.
Presencia ejecutiva y credibilidad para relacionarse con compradores senior como socio comercial, no como vendedor transaccional.
Capacidad para traducir temas técnicos y científicos en propuestas comerciales claras y concretas.

Dominio profesional del inglés, con capacidad para presentar y colaborar con stakeholders globales de manera regular.
Disponibilidad para viajar según sea necesario para conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.

Experiencia reciente en scale-ups, startups o empresas de tecnología de alto crecimiento.
Experiencia vendiendo categorías innovadoras a industrias tradicionales.
Conocimiento funcional del español.
Por Qué Regrow

Entorno de alto crecimiento tipo scale-up con autonomía y responsabilidad real.

title: Product designer lead (ux/ui) em araras (PB)
description: Professional English is a requirement for this role A challenge will be required for evaluation About Foundey Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage Saa S startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products. The Opportunity We are looking for a experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments. The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2 B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and Saa S sectors. Responsibilities Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design; Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions; Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and Saa S products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance; Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs; Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite; Stay updated on design trends, user behavior patterns in B2 B software, and industry best practices in product design; Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team. Requirements Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams; Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools; Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, Fig Jam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle; Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2 B software; Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers; Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles. Preferred Qualifications6+ years of experience as a Product Designer Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.); Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions; Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers; Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams; Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions. Why Join Us?At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing Saa S and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You'll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

title: Investment banking intern em vitória da conquista (BA)
description:
Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program
Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.
We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.
Only two students are selected per quarter for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.
What You'll Gain: Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2): The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including: 3-Statement Financial Modeling
Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis
Trading Comparables (Comps)
Precedent Transactions
Advanced Excel & Power Point techniques
Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies
Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10): Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with: Pitch Book Development
Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)
Financial Modeling
Sourcing & Due Diligence
Industry and Company Research
And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.
Mentorship & Feedback: Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.
This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.
Who We're Looking For:
This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment.
How to Apply:
Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.
This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

title: Commercial lead — brazil em alemanha (SE)
description:
About Regrow
Regrow is a climate-tech company on a mission to make resilient agriculture the global norm. We partner with food, beverage, textile, and financial sector leaders to measure, reduce, and report on the environmental impact of their agricultural supply chains. Our platform combines agronomic science, remote sensing, and data analytics to help organizations meet their sustainability goals while supporting farmers through the transition to regenerative practices.

About the Role
As Commercial Lead in Brazil, you will drive Regrow’s commercial growth in one of our most strategic markets. This is a full-cycle, new-business role: you will open new accounts, build and qualify pipeline, and close enterprise deals with customers across Brazil’s agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.
You will work closely with our Head of Lat Am, global go-to-market team, and customer success organization to bring Regrow’s platform to food and beverage brands, textile companies, biofuel producers, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, traders, banks, and financial institutions operating across grains, beef, and dairy value chains.
This is a plug-and-play role for a senior commercial professional who brings an established network and deep sector understanding. You will act as a market-opening engine, converting your credibility and relationships into new logos and meaningful ARR growth.

What You’ll Do
Own the full commercial cycle for new business in Brazil: prospecting, discovery, qualification, proposal, negotiation, and close.
Open doors with senior decision-makers and executive sponsors at strategic target accounts.
Build and maintain a qualified pipeline sourced exclusively from new accounts, with disciplined CRM hygiene and accurate forecasting.
Expand Regrow’s presence in priority verticals, including CPG, textiles, biofuels, agribusiness, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, and financial institutions.
Position Regrow credibly within Brazil’s grains, beef, and dairy value chains, adapting our narrative to local market context.
Partner with global GTM, product, science, and customer success teams to shape complex deals and ensure smooth post-close transitions.
Provide structured market intelligence on competitive dynamics, buyer needs, adoption barriers, and regulatory signals.
Represent Regrow at industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.
What You’ll Bring
Proven experience in hunting and opening new enterprise accounts in complex B2 B environments.
Track record of closing new business and an active network that can be activated in the short term.
Strong presence in agribusiness with real access to decision-makers across agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.
Deep understanding of Brazilian agri-food ecosystems and buyers such as CPGs, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, banks, and financial institutions.
Experience in or strong affinity with climate tech, sustainability, regenerative agriculture, carbon footprint, MRV, traceability, or Saa S platforms.
Executive presence and the credibility to engage senior buyers as a commercial partner, not a transactional seller.
Ability to translate technical and scientific topics into clear, concrete commercial proposals.
Comfort operating in a matrixed environment with global teams and in dynamic, high-growth contexts.
Native or near-native Portuguese fluency.
Professional working proficiency in English, with the ability to present to and collaborate with global stakeholders regularly.
Willingness to travel as needed for industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.
Nice to Have
Recent experience in scale-ups, startups, or high-growth technology companies.
Experience selling innovative categories into traditional industries.
Working knowledge of Spanish.
Why Regrow
Meaningful mission: shape the future of agriculture and help build climate resilience at scale.
High-growth, scale-up environment with autonomy and real ownership.
A collaborative global team combining commercial, scientific, and technical expertise.
Competitive compensation and benefits.
 
Acerca de Regrow
Regrow es una empresa de climate tech con la misión de convertir la agricultura resiliente en la norma global. Trabajamos con líderes de los sectores alimentario, de bebidas, textil y financiero para medir, reducir y reportar el impacto ambiental de sus cadenas de suministro agrícolas. Nuestra plataforma combina ciencia agronómica, sensores remotos y analítica de datos para ayudar a las organizaciones a alcanzar sus objetivos de sostenibilidad, apoyando al mismo tiempo a los productores en la transición hacia prácticas regenerativas.
Sobre el Rol
Como Commercial Lead — Brasil, impulsarás el crecimiento comercial de Regrow en uno de nuestros mercados más estratégicos. Este es un rol de ciclo completo enfocado en nuevos negocios: abrirás nuevas cuentas, construirás y calificarás pipeline, y cerrarás acuerdos enterprise con clientes a lo largo de las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial de Brasil.
Trabajarás en estrecha colaboración con nuestra Directora de Lat Am, el equipo global de go-to-market y la organización de customer success para llevar la plataforma de Regrow a marcas de alimentos y bebidas, empresas textiles, productores de biocombustibles, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, traders, bancos e instituciones financieras que operan en las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos.
Este es un rol plug-and-play para un profesional comercial senior que aporte una red establecida y un profundo conocimiento sectorial. Actuarás como motor de apertura de mercado, convirtiendo tu credibilidad y relaciones en nuevos logos y crecimiento significativo de ARR.
Qué Harás
Serás dueño del ciclo comercial completo de nuevos negocios en Brasil: prospección, descubrimiento, calificación, propuesta, negociación y cierre.
Abrirás puertas con tomadores de decisiones senior y sponsors ejecutivos en cuentas objetivo estratégicas.
Construirás y mantendrás un pipeline calificado proveniente exclusivamente de nuevas cuentas, con disciplina en CRM y precisión en el forecast.
Expandirás la presencia de Regrow en verticales prioritarias: CPG, textiles, biocombustibles, agronegocios, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos e instituciones financieras.
Posicionarás a Regrow con credibilidad dentro de las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos de Brasil, adaptando nuestra narrativa al contexto local.
Colaborarás con los equipos globales de GTM, producto, ciencia y customer success para estructurar acuerdos complejos y asegurar transiciones post-cierre fluidas.
Proporcionarás inteligencia estructurada de mercado sobre dinámicas competitivas, necesidades de compradores, barreras de adopción y señales regulatorias.
Representarás a Regrow en conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.
Qué Aportarás
Experiencia comprobada en hunting y apertura de nuevas cuentas enterprise en entornos B2 B complejos.
Historial de cierre de nuevos negocios y una red activa que pueda ser activada en el corto plazo.
Fuerte presencia en agronegocios con acceso real a tomadores de decisiones en las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial.
Comprensión profunda de los ecosistemas agroalimentarios brasileños y de compradores como CPGs, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, bancos e instituciones financieras.
Experiencia en o fuerte afinidad con climate tech, sostenibilidad, agricultura regenerativa, huella de carbono, MRV, trazabilidad o plataformas Saa S.
Presencia ejecutiva y credibilidad para relacionarse con compradores senior como socio comercial, no como vendedor transaccional.
Capacidad para traducir temas técnicos y científicos en propuestas comerciales claras y concretas.
Comodidad operando en un entorno matricial con equipos globales y en contextos dinámicos de alto crecimiento.
Dominio nativo o casi nativo del portugués.
Dominio profesional del inglés, con capacidad para presentar y colaborar con stakeholders globales de manera regular.
Disponibilidad para viajar según sea necesario para conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.
Deseable
Experiencia reciente en scale-ups, startups o empresas de tecnología de alto crecimiento.
Experiencia vendiendo categorías innovadoras a industrias tradicionales.
Conocimiento funcional del español.
Por Qué Regrow
Misión con propósito: dar forma al futuro de la agricultura y contribuir a construir resiliencia climática a escala.
Entorno de alto crecimiento tipo scale-up con autonomía y responsabilidad real.
Un equipo global colaborativo que combina experiencia comercial, científica y técnica.
Compensación y beneficios competitivos.

title: Senior hardware design engineer (in the netherlands) em alemanha (SE)
description:
At TOPIC (in the Netherlands), we work every day on high-tech innovations to make the world smarter, healthier, and better. Are you the Hardware Design Engineer with passionate about high-speed, low power designs that we are looking for?
“There is a lot of flexibility to educate yourself.”
Gijs van Esch I Hardware Engineer I TOPIC Embedded Systems
What will you do as a Senior Hardware Design Engineer?
As a Senior Hardware Design Engineer at TOPIC, you are a key member of our Hardware team and play an important role in complex development projects. You act as a trusted sparring partner for colleagues, customers, and other stakeholders, translating concepts into clear technical direction for the team. You take a leading role in the design of complex hardware systems while effectively prioritizing multiple projects and clients.
Your responsibilities as a Senior Hardware Design Engineer:
Implement a diverse range of innovative solutions across industries, from designing cutting-edge medical Io T devices to developing next-generation high-speed computing platforms and everything in between.
Take full ownership of design activities, ensuring the quality, integrity, and timely delivery of solutions.
Develop and validate complete hardware subsystems, based on high-level requirements and detailed project specifications.
Conduct in-depth analyses and studies, applying proven methodologies to deliver high-quality, effective solutions.
Participate in the entire development lifecycle: from system requirement gathering and translating these into hardware architecture, to PCB design & routing, schematic design, testing, and integration.
Provide senior-level expertise and guidance, supporting multiple teams within your domain and helping to elevate the overall technical craftsmanship of the organization.
Identify risks and opportunities both within and beyond the project scope, ensuring relevant stakeholders are engaged and proactive.
You are a sparring partner for junior engineers and your teammates.
You have a proven track record in a multidisciplinary team (SW/FW/HW)
Keeping up to date with the latest (high speed) technologies and converging them to the team.
What do we offer you?
This will make you smarter :
challenging and interesting projects in different domains;
benefit from the expertise of your technical buddy and more than 100 smart colleagues;
focus on guiding and coaching on personal development to achieve your ambitions;
annual study budget and customized training program within our TOPIC Academy;
tech events and knowledge sessions.
This will make you better :
Permanent contract;
An all-in employment package between €62.000 and €85.000 (including net expense allowance, mobility package, 13th-month bonus, and holiday allowance). Final salary is based on relevant work experience and level of expertise;
26 vacation days (opportunity to buy extra days), pension scheme and relocation budget (when you relocate to the Netherlands).
This will keep you healthy :
a good work-life balance, flexible working hours and hybrid way of working;
an inspiring office environment with daily fresh fruit and a gym;
the home office support package will turn your “home office” into an inspiring environment;
lots of fun during events like celebrations, sport activities and the weekly Friday afternoon drinks.
What do you bring as a Senior Hardware Design Engineer?
You have a Master's or Bachelor's degree in Electrical or Electronic Engineering and at least 5 years of professional experience;
You have a successful track record in high-tech hardware development projects (high-speed, low-power designs, combining FPGAs with ARM microprocessors, DDR4 memories, fast ADCs and radio modules such as Wi Fi and Bluetooth) and are familiar with tools such as Mentor Graphics Xpedition, Altium Designer, Hyper Linx;
You are proficient in the full development cycle; from the translation of system requirements into hardware design architecture and the schematic design, PCB design & routing to testing and integration;
You are used to working in a structured (ISO-13485) development process, and can prioritize multiple projects and clients;
You are communicative, have a can-do mentality and are a high-level conceptual thinker. This makes you a trusted sparring partner and able to take a lead role in designing complex hardware development projects;
You have excellent oral and written command of the English language is required for this role, command of the Dutch language is an advantage.
Our organization
Since 1996 we have been developing (embedded) systems that are essential for products manufactured by renowned high-tech companies around the world. Our projects involve edge to cloud solutions; from PCB design and FPGA to low level embedded software and application software for UI, Web, Mobile and cloud. We are well known for our high level of knowledge and expertise and are proud to be a Premier Adaptive Computing Partner of AMD; technology leader in the field of System-on-Chips and FPGAs.
Diversity & Inclusion
At TOPIC, we believe that true innovation happens when people with different backgrounds, ideas, and perspectives come together. Every talent counts, and every voice matters. Diversity strengthens our creativity, and inclusion ensures that everyone feels welcome and valued. We build a culture where everyone has the space to contribute and be themselves.

title: Commercial lead — brazil em mossoró (RN)
description:
About Regrow
Regrow is a climate-tech company on a mission to make resilient agriculture the global norm. We partner with food, beverage, textile, and financial sector leaders to measure, reduce, and report on the environmental impact of their agricultural supply chains. Our platform combines agronomic science, remote sensing, and data analytics to help organizations meet their sustainability goals while supporting farmers through the transition to regenerative practices.

About the Role
As Commercial Lead in Brazil, you will drive Regrow’s commercial growth in one of our most strategic markets. This is a full-cycle, new-business role: you will open new accounts, build and qualify pipeline, and close enterprise deals with customers across Brazil’s agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.
You will work closely with our Head of Lat Am, global go-to-market team, and customer success organization to bring Regrow’s platform to food and beverage brands, textile companies, biofuel producers, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, traders, banks, and financial institutions operating across grains, beef, and dairy value chains.
This is a plug-and-play role for a senior commercial professional who brings an established network and deep sector understanding. You will act as a market-opening engine, converting your credibility and relationships into new logos and meaningful ARR growth.

What You’ll Do
Own the full commercial cycle for new business in Brazil: prospecting, discovery, qualification, proposal, negotiation, and close.
Open doors with senior decision-makers and executive sponsors at strategic target accounts.
Build and maintain a qualified pipeline sourced exclusively from new accounts, with disciplined CRM hygiene and accurate forecasting.
Expand Regrow’s presence in priority verticals, including CPG, textiles, biofuels, agribusiness, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, and financial institutions.
Position Regrow credibly within Brazil’s grains, beef, and dairy value chains, adapting our narrative to local market context.
Partner with global GTM, product, science, and customer success teams to shape complex deals and ensure smooth post-close transitions.
Provide structured market intelligence on competitive dynamics, buyer needs, adoption barriers, and regulatory signals.
Represent Regrow at industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.
What You’ll Bring
Proven experience in hunting and opening new enterprise accounts in complex B2 B environments.

Acerca de Regrow
Regrow es una empresa de climate tech con la misión de convertir la agricultura resiliente en la norma global. Trabajamos con líderes de los sectores alimentario, de bebidas, textil y financiero para medir, reducir y reportar el impacto ambiental de sus cadenas de suministro agrícolas. Nuestra plataforma combina ciencia agronómica, sensores remotos y analítica de datos para ayudar a las organizaciones a alcanzar sus objetivos de sostenibilidad, apoyando al mismo tiempo a los productores en la transición hacia prácticas regenerativas.

Como Commercial Lead — Brasil, impulsarás el crecimiento comercial de Regrow en uno de nuestros mercados más estratégicos. Este es un rol de ciclo completo enfocado en nuevos negocios: abrirás nuevas cuentas, construirás y calificarás pipeline, y cerrarás acuerdos enterprise con clientes a lo largo de las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial de Brasil.

Expandirás la presencia de Regrow en verticales prioritarias: CPG, textiles, biocombustibles, agronegocios, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos e instituciones financieras.
Posicionarás a Regrow con credibilidad dentro de las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos de Brasil, adaptando nuestra narrativa al contexto local.
Colaborarás con los equipos globales de GTM, producto, ciencia y customer success para estructurar acuerdos complejos y asegurar transiciones post-cierre fluidas.
Proporcionarás inteligencia estructurada de mercado sobre dinámicas competitivas, necesidades de compradores, barreras de adopción y señales regulatorias.
Representarás a Regrow en conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.

Experiencia en o fuerte afinidad con climate tech, sostenibilidad, agricultura regenerativa, huella de carbono, MRV, trazabilidad o plataformas Saa S.
Presencia ejecutiva y credibilidad para relacionarse con compradores senior como socio comercial, no como vendedor transaccional.
Capacidad para traducir temas técnicos y científicos en propuestas comerciales claras y concretas.
Comodidad operando en un entorno matricial con equipos globales y en contextos dinámicos de alto crecimiento.
Dominio nativo o casi nativo del portugués.
Dominio profesional del inglés, con capacidad para presentar y colaborar con stakeholders globales de manera regular.
Disponibilidad para viajar según sea necesario para conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.

Job Summary: EY is seeking a highly skilled Senior People Soft DBA with 8+ years of experience to lead the administration, maintenance, and optimization of People Soft environments (HCM, FSCM, or Campus Solutions). Environment Management: Lead installation, configuration, and maintenance of People Soft application servers, web servers (Web Logic), and process schedulers.

Automation: Develop automation scripts (Shell, Python, Power Shell) for environment refreshes, backups, and monitoring.

Mentorship: Provide leadership and guidance to junior DBAs; collaborate with People Soft Developers and Functional Analysts.
Technical Skills Required

Experience with Exadata or OCI is a plus Middleware: Deep knowledge of Oracle Web Logic, Tuxedo, Integration Broker (IB) Operating Systems: Expert-level proficiency in Linux/Unix (OEL, Red Hat) and shell scripting Tools: Hands-on experience with People Tools or Stat for version control and migrations

description:

Acima de 6 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software
Acima de 4 anos com Node.js e Type Script em produção
Acima de 4 anos com bancos relacionais (My SQL), incluindo modelagem e otimização
Experiência com arquitetura de software (Clean Architecture, Hexagonal, DDD)
Experiência com cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure) e mensageria (Rabbit MQ/Kafka)
Experiência com APIs RESTful escaláveis
Experiência em ambientes de alta criticidade e alto volume de dados
Domínio de frameworks como Nest JS e/ou Next.js
Conhecimento em testes automatizados (TDD, unitários e integração)
Habilidade para trabalho colaborativo
Visão sistêmica e entendimento do impacto técnico no produto
Comunicação assertiva com clientes e time interno
Autonomia para conduzir projetos complexos e gerenciar riscos
Forte capacidade de resolução de problemas com foco na causa raiz

Vivência com pipelines de CI/CD (Bitbucket Pipelines, Git Hub Actions, Jenkins, etc.);
Conhecimentos em Segurança da Informação (OWASP, OAuth2).
Atribuições:
Interface Técnica com Clientes: Atuar como ponto focal em reuniões com os times de TI dos clientes (operadoras de saúde) para alinhar requisitos de integração, layouts de dados e especificações de API;

Arquitetura e Design: Projetar e desenvolver soluções escaláveis, resilientes e de alta performance utilizando Node.js (Nest JS/Next.js);
Sustentação e Confiabilidade: Atuar na manutenção dos sistemas em produção, identificando, diagnosticando e corrigindo bugs e falhas (em sistemas, fontes de dados e APIs) de forma ágil para garantir a continuidade dos serviços;
Mentoria e Qualidade: Realizar Code Reviews rigorosos e disseminar boas práticas (Clean Code, SOLID), elevando a barra técnica da equipe;
Padronização e Performance: Definir padrões de desenvolvimento e identificar gargalos de performance em cenários de alto volume de dados.

Modalidade Flexível: Híbrido ou 100% Remoto
Possibilidade de regime CLT ou PJ;
Se CLT, convênio com Bradesco Saúde e Cartão Flash (VR);

Autonomia para propor e implementar novas tecnologias!

title: Digital marketing ad strategist em canoas (PB)
description:
The Digital Marketing Ad Strategist is a responsible for the performance, health, and scalability of paid advertising accounts across Google Ads, Meta (Facebook & Instagram), and Linked In Ads. This role is heavily focused on account audits, ongoing optimization, technical troubleshooting, and performance improvements.
You will analyze existing ad accounts, identify inefficiencies and technical issues, recommend and implement fixes, and ensure tracking, structure, and strategy are aligned with business objectives.
Requirements
In-depth knowledge of the following platforms: Google ads, Facebook Ads, Microsoft Ads
Detail oriented
Key Responsibilities
Account Audits & Diagnostics
 • Conduct in-depth audits of Google Ads, Meta, Microsoft, and Linked In Ads accounts. Experience or working knowledge across secondary platforms, including Tik Tok, Pinterest, Reddit, X, Snapchat, Spotify, and Amazon.
 • Identify structural issues, wasted spend, tracking gaps, and performance blockers
 • Diagnose bugs and technical issues such as:
 • Incorrect or missing conversion tracking
 • Pixel or tag misfires
 • Attribution and reporting discrepancies
 • Budget pacing and delivery issues
 • Audience overlap and campaign cannibalization
 • Document findings and deliver clear, prioritized optimization recommendations
 Optimization & Performance Management
  • Continuous proactive optimization of campaigns, ad groups, keywords, audiences, bids, and creatives
 • Improve key performance metrics such as CPA, ROAS, CTR, and conversion rate
 • Manage and reallocate budgets based on performance and growth opportunities
 • Plan and execute A/B tests across targeting, creative, offers, and landing pages
 • Optimize accounts across full-funnel stages (awareness, consideration, conversion)
 Strategy & Execution
 • Translate business goals into effective paid media strategies
 • Ensure account structures align with funnel intent and buyer journeys
 • Align ad messaging with audience intent and platform best practices
 Tracking, Data & Reporting
 • Ensure accurate setup and ongoing validation of conversion tracking
 • Work with GA4, Google Tag Manager, and platform analytics to confirm data integrity
 • Analyze performance data to uncover insights, issues, and opportunities
 • Create performance reports that clearly explain results, risks, and next steps
 Process & Quality Control
  • Maintain clean account structure, naming conventions, and documentation
 • Build and follow optimization and audit checklists
 • Stay current on platform updates, policy changes, and best practices
 • Proactively flag risks, inefficiencies, or declining performance trends
Additional Tasks
 • Forecasts and initial ad spend recommendations to assist with the Sales team.
 • Have basic design knowledge and be able to coordinate ad copy and creative with internal team members.
Language Requirements
 • Fluent in English and Portuguese
Salary
$3000 BRL (Brazilian Real) / Per Month to start
Benefits after 6 months
Hiring Process:
Initial Interview with small knowledge test
Second interview with Ads team
Possible follow up questions / test
Final meet and greet meeting

title: Senior business analyst - supply chain em maceió (CE)
description:
Who We Are
We are an IFS integrator, providing end-to-end ERP implementation projects and exceptional support services. As strategic business partners, we collaborate with clients across key industries, helping them drive digital transformation.
Our global team of 200+ members brings extensive expertise, including former IFS customers who understand real-world operational challenges and dedicated IFS specialists with deep functional and technical knowledge. Together, we deliver outstanding services to reshape businesses and optimize supply chain operations.
Who We Are Looking For
We are currently seeking a Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain , a client-facing leadership role responsible for driving complex ERP implementations within supply chain domains (procurement, inventory, logistics, planning, and distribution).
This role requires a strong functional expert who can lead requirement gathering, solution design, and implementation while acting as a key advisor to clients and an escalation point for junior analysts.
If you are passionate about supply chain optimization, ERP transformation, and leading cross-functional collaboration in global projects, we encourage you to apply.
Key Responsibilities
Business Requirements & Client Engagement
• Lead requirement gathering sessions with stakeholders across supply chain functions.
• Analyze business processes (procurement, inventory, warehousing, logistics) to identify improvements and optimization opportunities.
• Translate complex supply chain and technical concepts into clear language for non-technical stakeholders.
• Perform gap analysis between current operations and ERP capabilities, ensuring scalable and efficient solutions.
• Advise clients on best practices aligned with industry standards and digital transformation strategies.
Solution Design, Implementation & Testing
• Lead supply chain module implementation within ERP (IFS or similar).
• Supervise and mentor Business Analysts and Junior Analysts within the domain.
• Collaborate with Project Managers on planning, estimations, and risk mitigation.
• Work closely with development and technical teams to ensure accurate solution delivery.
• Lead design discussions to align system architecture with business objectives.
• Ensure quality assurance testing and validation of supply chain functionalities.
• Support cross-functional alignment with Solution Architects and other domains.
• Deliver user training sessions and create functional documentation to ensure adoption.
Training, Expertise & Continuous Improvement (20%)
• Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in supply chain processes and ERP functionalities.
• Stay up to date with industry trends, including digital supply chain, automation, and best practices.
• Maintain relevant certifications (IFS or equivalent ERP modules).
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives across projects and internal practices.
Must Have
• Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Business, or related field.
• Minimum 5 years of experience in supply chain processes (procurement, logistics, inventory, planning).
• Minimum 3 years in client-facing roles.
• Experience in ERP implementation projects (IFS preferred).
• Strong understanding of supply chain operations across industries such as Manufacturing, Energy, Construction, or Services.
• Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish or French is a plus).
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.
• Experience with project management and collaboration tools.
• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office.
• Availability to travel.
• Legally authorized to work in Brazil.
What We Offer
• Competitive salary and benefits package.
• Career growth opportunities with certifications and professional development.
• A collaborative and international work environment.
• Involvement in high-impact global supply chain transformation projects.
Why Hoist?
If you are looking for an opportunity to lead impactful supply chain transformations and grow your career in a dynamic and global environment, Hoist is the place for you.
Join our team and be part of a people-first culture that values collaboration, innovation, and professional growth.

title: Ugc content creator em pôrto velho (PB)
description:
Location: Remote
Type: Freelance / Contract
Compensation: R$350 – R$450 per week (based on tier) + bonuses (based on views)
Probation period: 2 weeks, paid R$250 / week
About Pure
Pure is a bold, global dating app redefining how people connect. We believe dating should be honest, fun, and free of judgment, a space to explore confidence, chemistry, and self-expression.
We’re building a UGC Creator Community of voices to help tell that story.
About the UGC Creator Community 
We’re looking for social media creators to join our UGC Pure Dating App Creator Community - a group of UGC content creators producing short-form videos (Tik Tok / Instagram) around themes like dating, confidence, self-love, etc.
As a creator, you’ll have the chance to collaborate with our team, build your personal brand, and get paid to create authentic, engaging content that challenges the way people see dating.
What You’ll Do
Create and post 7 short-form videos per week (Tik Tok / Instagram Reels / You Tube Shorts, etc)
Develop content inspired by dating, connection, and self-expression
Drive people to the app 
Participate in creative briefs, trend challenges, and campaigns
Receive feedback and coaching to grow your performance
Collaborate with our team on storytelling ideas and social strategies
What We’re Looking For
You must be based in Brazil and be fluent in Portuguese 
Passion for storytelling, social media, and modern culture
Familiarity with Tik Tok trends, Reels formats, and UGC-style videos
Strong on-camera presence and editing skills
Consistency and ability to meet weekly content goals
Open-minded and comfortable creating content about dating and relationships
Payment Structure
Tiered structure paid weekly
Bonuses for views (starting from 100 K+ views)
Bonuses for registrations
Payments are made weekly
Why Join Us
Get paid to create authentic content about dating & self-expression
Access creative guidance, briefs, and a global network of creators
Build your portfolio while collaborating 
Enjoy creative freedom - your tone, your story, your perspective
How to Apply
Send us your cover letter and tell us a bit about yourself, including why you’d like to work with Pure app. 
You’ll be invited to join a group onboarding call and receive a task to create a test submission video. 
After that, you’ll enter a 2-week trial period, and if successful, you’ll be fully onboarded into the program.
Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

The Methodical Group (methodicalgroup. Our client is seeking an Implementation Analyst to support their Professional Services team, leading end-to-end deployments of a Saa S platform across municipal government clients. Deliver customer training sessions to ensure user adoption and proficiency across departments.
Monitor project timelines, proactively managing scope, risks, dependencies, and overall project health.
Document configurations, implementation decisions, and knowledge base materials to support consistency and scalability.
Collaborate with Product, Support, and Customer Success teams to ensure smooth transition and ongoing client success post-launch.
Identify opportunities for process improvement and recommend best practices to optimize future implementations. Qualifications
At least 2 years of Professional Services or Implementation experience supporting Enterprise Saa S products.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
Strong understanding of Saa S platforms, cloud environments, and data management principles.
Working knowledge of data concepts such as file formats, field mapping, and data validation, with the ability to coordinate effectively with technical teams.
Experience using tools such as Wrike, Hub Spot, Salesforce, Jira, or similar implementation and project tracking platforms.
Proven experience working directly with clients and managing multiple implementation projects simultaneously.
Ability to manage client relationships professionally, set expectations, and communicate effectively throughout the project lifecycle.
Strong ability to translate technical concepts into clear, business-friendly language.
Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, organizational, and time-management skills.
Ability to quickly learn new technologies, tools, and business domains.

title: Investment banking intern em timon (MA)
description:
Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program
Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.
We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.

Precedent Transactions
Advanced Excel & Power Point techniques
Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies

For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with: Pitch Book Development
Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)
Financial Modeling
Sourcing & Due Diligence
Industry and Company Research
And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.
Mentorship & Feedback: Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.
This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.
Who We're Looking For:
This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment.
How to Apply:
Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.
This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

description:
Location: Remote
Type: Freelance / Contract
Compensation: R$350 – R$450 per week (based on tier) + bonuses (based on views)
Probation period: 2 weeks, paid R$250 / week
About Pure
Pure is a bold, global dating app redefining how people connect. We believe dating should be honest, fun, and free of judgment, a space to explore confidence, chemistry, and self-expression.
We’re building a UGC Creator Community of voices to help tell that story.
About the UGC Creator Community
We’re looking for social media creators to join our UGC Pure Dating App Creator Community - a group of UGC content creators producing short-form videos (Tik Tok / Instagram) around themes like dating, confidence, self-love, etc.
As a creator, you’ll have the chance to collaborate with our team, build your personal brand, and get paid to create authentic, engaging content that challenges the way people see dating.
What You’ll Do
Create and post 7 short-form videos per week (Tik Tok / Instagram Reels / You Tube Shorts, etc)
Develop content inspired by dating, connection, and self-expression
Drive people to the app
Participate in creative briefs, trend challenges, and campaigns
Receive feedback and coaching to grow your performance
Collaborate with our team on storytelling ideas and social strategies
What We’re Looking For
You must be based in Brazil and be fluent in Portuguese
Passion for storytelling, social media, and modern culture
Familiarity with Tik Tok trends, Reels formats, and UGC-style videos
Strong on-camera presence and editing skills
Consistency and ability to meet weekly content goals
Open-minded and comfortable creating content about dating and relationships
Payment Structure
Tiered structure paid weekly
Bonuses for views (starting from 100 K+ views)
Bonuses for registrations
Payments are made weekly
Why Join Us
Get paid to create authentic content about dating & self-expression
Access creative guidance, briefs, and a global network of creators
Build your portfolio while collaborating
Enjoy creative freedom - your tone, your story, your perspective
How to Apply
Send us your cover letter and tell us a bit about yourself, including why you’d like to work with Pure app.
You’ll be invited to join a group onboarding call and receive a task to create a test submission video.
After that, you’ll enter a 2-week trial period, and if successful, you’ll be fully onboarded into the program.
Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

title: Artificial intelligence engineer em boa vista (RN)
description:

Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)
Contract Duration: Long Term
Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)
Work Hours: PST
Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)
Overview
We are seeking an experienced AI Engineer to drive AI-first engineering practices and enable developer productivity at scale. This role sits at the intersection of Developer Experience, Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, and Applied AI , focused on integrating AI-assisted tooling, LLM workflows, and automation into the software development lifecycle.
The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience with LLM APIs, AI developer tooling, Python automation, cloud infrastructure, and developer productivity metrics , while helping shape internal AI governance, adoption frameworks, and scalable engineering “golden paths.”
Key Responsibilities Champion an AI-first engineering culture through reusable playbooks, golden-path templates, and best practices that improve developer productivity. Define and measure impact using DORA and SPACE metrics , driving improvements across engineering workflows. Build reusable patterns for:
AI-assisted code generation
Pull request automation
Test generation
Debugging workflows
Developer self-service enablement
Evaluate, prototype, and lead POCs for AI tools , providing recommendations based on ROI, usability, technical merit, and stakeholder feedback. Manage AI usage governance, including:
Token budgeting and cost controls
Usage monitoring and reporting
PII redaction guardrails
Audit logging and responsible AI practices
Develop lightweight AWS-based infrastructure supporting LLM pipelines , APIs, and AI integrations. Integrate AI tooling into Git Lab CI/CD, Git Ops workflows, and developer platforms . Instrument AI workflows with observability metrics and usage signals to support adoption and optimization.
Partner with engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to drive AI enablement initiatives.
Required Qualifications 8+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, Developer Experience , or related engineering roles. Strong hands-on experience with LLM APIs and AI-assisted developer tooling in production or enterprise settings. Strong Python development skills for automation and AI workflow integrations.
Experience evaluating, procuring, or governing AI/Saa S tools , including vendor assessments, licensing, and cost management. Practical daily usage of tools such as Git Hub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Chat GPT , or similar. Experience designing scalable developer workflows, internal platforms, or self-service engineering capabilities.
Strong AWS experience, ideally including:
Bedrock
API Gateway
Managed AI/Cloud Services
Experience with Terraform, Helm, Git Ops, and CI/CD pipelines (Git Lab preferred). Strong observability mindset with experience defining meaningful metrics and instrumentation.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Preferred / Nice to Have Experience contributing to an AI Enablement function, Developer Experience program, or Center of Excellence . Hands-on experience with:
LLM Agents
RAG pipelines
Vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector, Open Search, etc.)
Lang Chain / Llama Index
Exposure to AI Fin Ops , usage reporting, and cost attribution models. Knowledge of AI governance and security , including: OWASP Top 10 for LLMs
Prompt injection risks
Model supply chain security
Responsible AI controls
Financial services or insurance domain experience is a plus.

title: Investment banking intern em caruaru (PE)
description:
Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program
Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.
We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.
Only two students are selected per quarter for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.
What You'll Gain: Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2): The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including: 3-Statement Financial Modeling
Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis
Trading Comparables (Comps)
Precedent Transactions
Advanced Excel & Power Point techniques
Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies
Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10): Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with: Pitch Book Development
Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)
Financial Modeling
Sourcing & Due Diligence
Industry and Company Research
And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.
Mentorship & Feedback: Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.
This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.
Who We're Looking For:
This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment.
How to Apply:
Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.
This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

* Organização e acompanhamento da evolução das pacientes

O perfil que buscamos
* Profissional com segurança técnica na execução de procedimentos
* Organização, responsabilidade e atenção ao detalhe
* Facilidade para lidar com rotina dinâmica e múltiplas demandas
* Boa comunicação com pacientes e equipe
* Disposição para atuar tanto em atendimentos próprios quanto em suporte direto ao médico
* Interesse em aprender e evoluir no uso de tecnologias da clínica
Se você busca apenas atender seus próprios pacientes, sem envolvimento com a rotina da clínica, essa vaga não é para você.
⸻
Requisitos obrigatórios
* Formação na área da saúde (Enfermagem, Biomedicina, Fisioterapia, Estética ou correlatas)

* Experiência em clínica de cirurgia plástica

* Interesse em crescimento dentro da clínica

Modelo de trabalho
* Atuação presencial, com agenda própria dentro da clínica
* Remuneração com base + variável conforme produção

⸻
Cultura da Arte Clínica
Trabalhamos com alto nível de exigência, proximidade com o paciente e atenção aos detalhes.
Buscamos pessoas comprometidas, organizadas e que queiram crescer junto com a clínica.

Esta vaga exige envolvimento real com a rotina da clínica, tanto em atendimentos próprios quanto no suporte ao médico.
Se você prefere um modelo mais independente ou com menor nível de exigência, essa vaga provavelmente não é para você.

Seu papel será estruturar essa fundação: definir a arquitetura, organizar os dados, criar pipelines confiáveis e habilitar a criação de produtos de dados que apoiem decisões críticas de negócio. O que esperamos de você: Experiência sólida como Data Engineer , com forte mentalidade de engenharia (Data Engineer aqui é dev); Domínio de Python e SQLpara construção de pipelines e soluções de dados em produção; Experiência prática com AWS , especialmente serviços como S3, Athena e IAM; Conhecimento e uso de Infraestrutura como Código (Ia C) ; Vivência com pipelines de dados em produção, lidando com volumes relevantes e dados sensíveis; Forte preocupação comsegurança da informação , padrões de projeto e boas práticas de engenharia; Experiência emambientes de startup , lidando com pouco legado e muita construção do zero; Autonomia para tomar decisões técnicas e conduzir projetos end-to-end; Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções de dados escaláveis; Comunicação clara e estruturada, especialmente em ambientes assíncronos. Será considerado um diferencial: Experiência com arquiteturas de dados modernas, como lakehouse; Uso de ferramentas de orquestração e transformação de dados (ex: Airflow, dbt ou similares); Atuação em domínios complexos e regulados, como financeiro, crédito ou seguros; Vivência na construção e estruturação de plataformas ou áreas de dados desde o início. title: English teacher em recife (PE)
description: Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you! Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone. If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach! Whether you're looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we've got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week. What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at Latin Hire? You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts. If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out. When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire: Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week! Who we are: Established in 2003, Latin Hire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Operations director em pôrto velho (PB)
description:
Kinetic Homes - Operations Director
Introduction:
Kinetic Homes is a homebuilder based in Jacksonville FL focused on expanding homeownership by constructing high quality, affordable homes in vibrant neighborhoods. The business was founded by Erik Nordahl and has built & sold over 100 homes over the past 3 years.
This role will be an early hire in a rapidly growing organization. The individual for this role will report directly to the founder, Erik Nordahl. Mentorship and professional development are critical to Erik, and he will seek to assist his colleagues in their professional development and share the learnings he has accumulated throughout his career. This individual will have opportunity to eventually manage a team of individual contributors in the future.
Compensation: $40,000-90,000 USD per year.
Duties & Responsibilities:
Permitting
Ensure all necessary permits are obtained for new construction projects.
Complete and submit permit applications for new construction.
Assist with septic permits and HOA applications.
Address permit application rejections in a timely manner.
Facilitate communication between surveyors, architects, engineers, etc. via email and phone.
Regularly call and email vendors and city officials to ensure timely deliverables.
Maintain database to ensure files are updated with all necessary documentation.
Maintain a knowledge of and be prepared to answer questions about the status of permits for all new construction.
Development Support
Prepare permit packages to be sent to our field development team.
File required documentation through online portals to be recorded with the appropriate county.
Procurement
Regularly solicit updated pricing among vendors to ensure we are obtaining competitive pricing.
Request purchase orders for active jobs that are under construction.
Check invoices from vendors to ensure that invoiced amounts match master pricing agreements.
Transaction Support
Prepare drafts of Purchase & Sale contracts.
Assist team in due diligence process coordination for all transactions.
Maintain closing calendars for transactions to ensure team is aware of key deadlines and terms.
Qualifications:
University degree. Four or more years of successful experience in a professional work environment
Strong skills in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel) and Adobe PDF.
Interest and use of latest AI technology products is key. Interest and curiosity in how to streamline operations through AI and technology is viewed positively.
Possess strong verbal and written English skills.
Must be highly organized and attentive to detail.
Willing to work in high-pressure environment.
Willing to be responsive and communicative.
Availability is key. Candidate must be willing to respond to time-sensitive requests outside of normal working hours. Normal working hours are 9 AM to 5 PM EST.
The team member may occasionally be asked to work weekends, but that is abnormal.
Good attitude necessary.

title: Sr content distribution manager, international em brasília (RN)
description:
OverviewTeamwork makes the stream work.Roku is changing how the world watches TVRoku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U. S., Canada, and Mexico, and we\'ve set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.
From your first day at Roku, you\'ll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We\'re a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.
About the TeamRoku’s Content Distribution team sources, negotiates, and closes distribution agreements with the streaming video providers and major TV networks for carriage of their content and service on the Roku platform.
About the roleThe Senior Content Distribution Manager will be a key member of the team, leading negotiations for app distribution and securing Premium Subscription partnerships to enhance Roku\'s content offerings and drive platform growth. The ideal candidate will have exceptional negotiation skills and be comfortable working in a high-volume, fast-paced environment with evolving priorities. In addition, the candidate must be a strong communicator who can build and manage relationships and interact with executives both internally and externally.
In this role, you will report to the Director of Content Distribution LATAM, based in Brazil.
What you will be doingNegotiate distribution and premium subscriptions/channels agreements with direct-to-consumer streaming services.
Prepare renewal strategy documents, quarterly company updates, and board presentations about content deals and the overall media landscape.
Participate in all aspects of new business development (deal sourcing, term sheet drafting, long-form drafting, contract negotiation, ongoing relationship management, etc.).
Work with Roku’s legal team to manage the installed base of contracts and negotiate renewals.
Manage and evaluate potential channel partners through content analysis, market demand/appeal, competitive positioning, and financial modeling.
Work cross-functionally with other teams (e.g., marketing, finance, ad sales, engineering) to support and manage relationships with existing partners.
We\'re excited if you have8+ years’ experience in content distribution for a major MVPD or content distributor/media company with a track record of closing deals with media companies or content distributors.
Demonstrated passion and understanding of the media landscape and a solid understanding of streaming media technologies.
Excellent deal project management, leading deals from start to end.
Experience working directly with legal teams in reviewing and drafting distribution agreements.
Proven planning, prioritization, and organizational skills in a fast-paced environment
Skilled communicator with excellent verbal, presentation, and written communication abilities in English. Portuguese will be highly appreciated.
Strong ability to build and cultivate internal and external relationships.
Demonstrated experience in market analysis, competitive analysis, and strategic thinking.
BA/BS required.
Our Hybrid Work ApproachRoku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are flexible for remote work except for employees whose roles are required to be in the office five days a week or employees who are in offices with a five day in office policy.
BenefitsRoku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Our employees can take time off work for vacation and other personal reasons to balance their evolving work and life needs. It\'s important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.
AccommodationsRoku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to Employee
The Roku CultureRoku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company\'s success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We\'re independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you\'ll be part of a company that\'s changing how the world watches TV.
We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn\'t real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002.
